    when auth.jwt() is null then true
    when auth.jwt() -> 'act' ->> 'kind' = 'support'

    when auth.jwt() -> 'act' ->> 'kind' = 'agent'

    when auth.jwt() -> 'act' ->> 'session_id' is not null

functions.name: ai_cache_get
ai_cache_set
functions.definition:
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_row "better_supabase"."ai_cache_entries"%rowtype;
begin
  if ai_cache_set.ttl is null or ai_cache_set.ttl < 1 then
    raise exception 'ttl must be at least one second' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'AI_CACHE_INVALID';
  end if;
  insert into "better_supabase"."ai_cache_entries" ("key", "organization_id", "kind", "model", "value", "expires_at")
  values (ai_cache_set.key, ai_cache_set.tenant, coalesce(ai_cache_set.kind, 'generate'), ai_cache_set.model, ai_cache_set.value,
    now() + make_interval(secs => least(ai_cache_set.ttl, 604800)))
  on conflict ("key") do update set
    "organization_id" = excluded."organization_id",
    "kind" = excluded."kind",
    "model" = excluded."model",
    "value" = excluded."value",
    "hits" = 0,
    "created_at" = now(),
    "last_hit_at" = null,
    "expires_at" = excluded."expires_at"
  returning * into v_row;
  return jsonb_build_object('key', v_row."key", 'organization_id', v_row."organization_id", 'kind', v_row."kind", 'model', v_row."model", 'value', v_row."value", 'hits', v_row."hits", 'created_at', v_row."created_at", 'last_hit_at', v_row."last_hit_at", 'expires_at', v_row."expires_at") - 'value';
end;

functions.name: ai_message_path_of
functions.definition:
with recursive up as (
    select x.*, 0 as depth from "better_supabase"."ai_messages" x
    where x."chat_id" = ai_message_path_of.chat and x."id" = ai_message_path_of.leaf
    union all
    select x.*, up.depth + 1 from "better_supabase"."ai_messages" x
    join up on x."chat_id" = up."chat_id" and x."id" = up."parent_id"
    where up.depth < 10000
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object('id', up."id", 'parent_id', up."parent_id", 'role', up."role", 'parts', up."parts", 'metadata', up."metadata", 'format', up."format", 'native', case when ai_message_path_of.include_native then up."native" end, 'model', up."model", 'status', up."status", 'created_at', up."created_at") || jsonb_build_object(
      'sibling_count', (select count(*) from "better_supabase"."ai_messages" sb where sb."chat_id" = up."chat_id" and sb."parent_id" is not distinct from up."parent_id"),
      'sibling_index', (select count(*) from "better_supabase"."ai_messages" sb where sb."chat_id" = up."chat_id" and sb."parent_id" is not distinct from up."parent_id" and sb."seq" < up."seq")
    )
    order by up.depth desc
  ), '[]'::jsonb)
  from up;

 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER

AS $function$
  with recursive up as (
    select x.*, 0 as depth from "better_supabase"."ai_messages" x
    where x."chat_id" = ai_message_path_of.chat and x."id" = ai_message_path_of.leaf
    union all
    select x.*, up.depth + 1 from "better_supabase"."ai_messages" x
    join up on x."chat_id" = up."chat_id" and x."id" = up."parent_id"
    where up.depth < 10000
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object('id', up."id", 'parent_id', up."parent_id", 'role', up."role", 'parts', up."parts", 'metadata', up."metadata", 'format', up."format", 'native', case when ai_message_path_of.include_native then up."native" end, 'model', up."model", 'status', up."status", 'created_at', up."created_at") || jsonb_build_object(
      'sibling_count', (select count(*) from "better_supabase"."ai_messages" sb where sb."chat_id" = up."chat_id" and sb."parent_id" is not distinct from up."parent_id"),
      'sibling_index', (select count(*) from "better_supabase"."ai_messages" sb where sb."chat_id" = up."chat_id" and sb."parent_id" is not distinct from up."parent_id" and sb."seq" < up."seq")

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.approve_timesheet(timesheet_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_sheet "better_supabase"."timesheets"%rowtype;
begin
  update "better_supabase"."timesheets" s set "approved_at" = now()
    where s."id" = approve_timesheet.timesheet_id and s."approved_at" is null
    returning * into v_sheet;
  if found then
    perform "better_supabase".emit_event('timesheet.approved', jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_sheet."tenant_id", 'id', v_sheet."id", 'userId', v_sheet."user_id", 'week', v_sheet."week", 'approvalId', v_sheet."approval_id"), 'timesheets/' || v_sheet."id"::text, (v_sheet."tenant_id")::text, null, 'better-supabase/time-tracking');
  perform better_supabase.audit_event(
    event_type => 'timesheet.approved',
    category => 'data',
    target_type => 'timesheet',
    record_id => v_sheet."id"::text,
    summary => 'approved a timesheet' || ' for the week of ' || v_sheet."week"::text,
    tenant => (v_sheet."tenant_id")::uuid,
    metadata => jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_sheet."tenant_id", 'id', v_sheet."id", 'userId', v_sheet."user_id", 'week', v_sheet."week", 'approvalId', v_sheet."approval_id")
  );
  end if;
end;
$function$

select exists (
    select 1 from "better_supabase"."attachments" a
    where a."bucket" = attachment_object_allowed.bucket and a."object_path" = attachment_object_allowed.path
      and case attachment_object_allowed.action
        when 'insert' then a."status" = 'pending' and a."uploaded_at" is null and a."uploaded_by" = auth.uid()
        when 'select' then (a."status" in ('pending', 'clean', 'failed') and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', a."organization_id", 'attachments.read'), false))
          or a."uploaded_by" = auth.uid() or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', a."organization_id", 'attachments.manage'), false)
        when 'delete' then a."uploaded_by" = auth.uid() or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', a."organization_id", 'attachments.manage'), false)
        else false
      end
  )

declare
  existing text;
  entry_id "better_supabase"."audit_events"."id"%type;

  if restricted is not null or ip is not null or user_agent is not null or session_id is not null then
    raise exception 'audit_event got restricted details, and the audit module has no restricted table'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'Set blocks.audit.options.restricted to true.';
  end if;
  actor_id := coalesce(actor_id, auth.uid());
  if idempotency_key is not null then
    perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(pg_catalog.hashtext('better_supabase.audit_event'), pg_catalog.hashtext(coalesce(tenant::text, '') || ':' || idempotency_key));
    select l."id"::text into existing
    from "better_supabase"."audit_events" l
    where l."idempotency_key" = audit_event_trusted.idempotency_key
      and l."organization_id" is not distinct from audit_event_trusted.tenant
    limit 1;
    if existing is not null then
      return existing;
    end if;
  end if;
  insert into "better_supabase"."audit_events" ("table_name", "record_id", "op", "actor_id", "actor_role", "organization_id", "impersonated_by", "impersonation_reason", "support_session_id", "event_type", "category", "outcome", "source", "target_type", "metadata", "idempotency_key", "actor_kind", "actor_label", "tenant_label", "target_label", "summary", "request_id", "correlation_id", "scope")
  values (
    null,
    record_id,
    'event',
    actor_id,
    coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'role', current_user),
    tenant,
    coalesce(audit_event_trusted.impersonated_by, case when auth.jwt() -> 'act' ->> 'sub' ~ '^[0-9a-f-]{36}$' then (auth.jwt() -> 'act' ->> 'sub')::uuid end),
    coalesce(audit_event_trusted.impersonation_reason, auth.jwt() -> 'act' ->> 'reason'),
    coalesce(audit_event_trusted.support_session, case when auth.jwt() -> 'act' ->> 'session_id' ~ '^[0-9a-f-]{36}$' then (auth.jwt() -> 'act' ->> 'session_id')::uuid end),
    event_type,
    coalesce(category, 'system'),
    coalesce(outcome, 'success'),
    coalesce(source, 'app'),
    target_type,
    coalesce(metadata, '{}'),
    idempotency_key,
    coalesce(actor_kind, case
      when coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'role', '') = 'service_role' then 'service'
      when auth.jwt() -> 'act' ->> 'kind' = 'support' then 'support'
      when auth.jwt() -> 'act' is not null then 'impersonation'
      when auth.jwt() ->> 'client_id' is not null then 'oauth-client'
      when auth.uid() is not null then 'user'
      else 'system'
    end),
    coalesce(actor_label, coalesce(auth.jwt() -> 'user_metadata' ->> 'full_name', auth.jwt() ->> 'email')),
    (select o."name"::text from "public"."organizations" o where o."id" = tenant),
    target_label,
    summary,
    coalesce(better_supabase.request_id_or_null(request_id), coalesce(better_supabase.request_id_or_null(current_setting('better_supabase.request_id', true)), better_supabase.request_id_or_null(better_supabase.request_header('x-request-id')))),
    coalesce(better_supabase.request_id_or_null(correlation_id), coalesce(better_supabase.request_id_or_null(current_setting('better_supabase.correlation_id', true)), better_supabase.request_id_or_null(better_supabase.request_header('x-correlation-id')))),
    coalesce(audit_event_trusted.scope, case when tenant is null then 'platform' else 'tenant' end)
  )
  returning "id" into entry_id;
  return entry_id::text;
end;

functions.name: audit_revert_source
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.audit_revert_source(entries text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  found_entries jsonb;
begin
  if cardinality(audit_revert_source.entries) > 1000 then
    raise exception 'revert at most 1000 entries at once' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'AUDIT_REVERT_TOO_MANY';
  end if;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', l."id"::text,
      'table', to_regclass(quote_ident(split_part(l."table_name", '.', 1)) || '.' || quote_ident(split_part(l."table_name", '.', 2)))::text,
      'op', l."op",
      'old', l."old_record",
      'new', l."new_record",
      'changed', to_jsonb(l."changed"),
      'keys', to_jsonb(coalesce(
        (select a.key_columns from better_supabase.audited_tables a where a.target = to_regclass(quote_ident(split_part(l."table_name", '.', 1)) || '.' || quote_ident(split_part(l."table_name", '.', 2)))),
        (select array_agg(att.attname::text order by k.ord)
         from pg_catalog.pg_index i
         cross join lateral unnest(i.indkey) with ordinality k(attnum, ord)
         join pg_catalog.pg_attribute att on att.attrelid = i.indrelid and att.attnum = k.attnum
         where i.indrelid = to_regclass(quote_ident(split_part(l."table_name", '.', 1)) || '.' || quote_ident(split_part(l."table_name", '.', 2))) and i.indisprimary)
      ))
    ) order by l."occurred_at" desc, l."id" desc), '[]'::jsonb)
  into found_entries
  from "better_supabase"."audit_events" l
  
  where l."id"::text = any (audit_revert_source.entries)
    and (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin')
      or (l."organization_id" is not null and coalesce(better_supabase.member_can(auth.uid(), l."organization_id", 'audit.revert'), false)));
  if jsonb_array_length(found_entries) <> cardinality(array(select distinct e from unnest(audit_revert_source.entries) e)) then
    raise exception 'an entry is missing or not yours to revert' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'AUDIT_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  return found_entries;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.audit_schema(schema_name text, tenant_column text, exempt text[] DEFAULT '{}'::text[])
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  registered integer := 0;
  target regclass;
begin
  for target in
    select format('%I.%I', n.nspname, c.relname)::regclass
    from pg_catalog.pg_class c
    join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
    where n.nspname = schema_name
      and c.relkind in ('r', 'p')
      and not c.relispartition
      and exists (
        select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
        where a.attrelid = c.oid and a.attname = audit_schema.tenant_column and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped
      )
      and not exists (select 1 from unnest(exempt) e where c.relname like e)
      and not exists (
        select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_trigger t where t.tgrelid = c.oid and t.tgname = 'bs_audit'
      )
    order by c.relname
  loop
    perform better_supabase.audit(target);
    registered := registered + 1;
  end loop;
  return registered;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.chat_install(adapter text, external_id text, tenant uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, credential_ref jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, installed_by uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_previous jsonb;
  v_row "better_supabase"."chat_installations"%rowtype;
begin
  select "credential_ref" into v_previous from "better_supabase"."chat_installations"
  where "adapter" = chat_install.adapter and "external_id" = chat_install.external_id
  for update;
  insert into "better_supabase"."chat_installations" as i ("tenant_id", "adapter", "external_id", "credential_ref", "installed_by", "metadata")
  values (tenant, adapter, external_id, credential_ref, installed_by, coalesce(metadata, '{}'::jsonb))
  on conflict ("adapter", "external_id") do update
    set "tenant_id" = coalesce(excluded."tenant_id", i."tenant_id"),
        "credential_ref" = excluded."credential_ref",
        "installed_by" = coalesce(excluded."installed_by", i."installed_by"),
        "metadata" = i."metadata" || excluded."metadata",
        "installed_at" = clock_timestamp(),
        "uninstalled_at" = null
  returning * into v_row;
  return to_jsonb(v_row) || jsonb_build_object(
    'previous_credential_ref',
    case when v_previous is distinct from v_row."credential_ref" then v_previous end
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.chat_state_acquire_lock(prefix text, thread_id text, token text, ttl_ms integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_lock "better_supabase"."chat_state_locks"%rowtype;
begin
  insert into "better_supabase"."chat_state_locks" as l ("key_prefix", "thread_id", "token", "expires_at")
  values (prefix, thread_id, token, clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => greatest(coalesce(ttl_ms, 0), 1) / 1000.0))
  on conflict ("key_prefix", "thread_id") do update
    set "token" = excluded."token", "expires_at" = excluded."expires_at", "updated_at" = clock_timestamp()
    where l."expires_at" <= clock_timestamp()
  returning * into v_lock;
  if not found then
    return null;
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('thread_id', v_lock."thread_id", 'token', v_lock."token", 'expires_at', v_lock."expires_at");
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: prefix text, thread_id text, token text, ttl_ms integer

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.chat_state_append_to_list(prefix text, key text, value jsonb, max_length integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, ttl_ms integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_expires timestamptz := case when ttl_ms is null or ttl_ms <= 0 then null else clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => ttl_ms / 1000.0) end;
begin
  insert into "better_supabase"."chat_state_lists" ("key_prefix", "list_key", "value", "expires_at")
  values (prefix, key, value, v_expires);
  if max_length is not null and max_length > 0 then
    delete from "better_supabase"."chat_state_lists" l
    where l."key_prefix" = chat_state_append_to_list.prefix and l."list_key" = chat_state_append_to_list.key
      and l."id" < (
        select k."id" from "better_supabase"."chat_state_lists" k
        where k."key_prefix" = chat_state_append_to_list.prefix and k."list_key" = chat_state_append_to_list.key
        order by k."id" desc
        offset max_length - 1 limit 1
      );
  end if;
  update "better_supabase"."chat_state_lists" l set "expires_at" = v_expires
  where l."key_prefix" = chat_state_append_to_list.prefix and l."list_key" = chat_state_append_to_list.key
    and l."expires_at" is distinct from v_expires;
end;
$function$

AS $function$
declare
  v_value jsonb;
begin
  delete from "better_supabase"."chat_state_queues" q
  where q."key_prefix" = chat_state_dequeue.prefix and q."thread_id" = chat_state_dequeue.thread_id
    and q."expires_at" <= clock_timestamp();
  delete from "better_supabase"."chat_state_queues" q
  where q."id" = (
    select k."id" from "better_supabase"."chat_state_queues" k
    where k."key_prefix" = chat_state_dequeue.prefix and k."thread_id" = chat_state_dequeue.thread_id
    order by k."id"
    limit 1
    for update skip locked
  )
  returning q."value" into v_value;
  return v_value;
end;
$function$

functions.name: claim_notification_deliveries
functions.definition:
declare
  claimed jsonb;
begin
  -- A delivery whose lease ran out on its last attempt lost its worker.
  update "better_supabase"."notification_deliveries" d
  set "status" = 'failed', "error" = 'The lease ran out on the last attempt'
  where d."channel" = claim_notification_deliveries.channel
    and d."status" = 'pending'
    and d."attempts" >= greatest(1, coalesce(claim_notification_deliveries.max_attempts, 5))
    and d."attempted_at" < now() - claim_notification_deliveries.lease;

  with picked as (
    select d."id" as id from "better_supabase"."notification_deliveries" d
    where d."channel" = claim_notification_deliveries.channel
      and d."status" = 'pending'
      and d."next_attempt_at" <= now()
      and (d."attempted_at" is null or d."attempted_at" < now() - claim_notification_deliveries.lease)
    order by d."created_at"
    limit claim_notification_deliveries.max_items
    for update skip locked
  ), leased as (
    update "better_supabase"."notification_deliveries" d set "attempted_at" = now(), "attempts" = d."attempts" + 1
    from picked where d."id" = picked.id
    returning d.*
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'delivery_id', l."id",
    'channel', l."channel",
    'attempts', l."attempts",
    'user_id', rc."user_id",
    'email', u.email,
    'notification', jsonb_build_object('id', rc."id", 'event_id', ev."id", 'type', ev."type", 'data', ev."data", 'created_at', rc."created_at", 'read_at', rc."read_at", 'tenant', ev."organization_id", 'actor_id', ev."actor_id", 'subject_type', ev."subject_type", 'subject_id', ev."subject_id", 'subject_label', ev."subject_label", 'summary', ev."summary", 'action_path', ev."action_path", 'priority', ev."priority", 'resolved_at', rc."resolved_at"),
    'suppressed', s."reason"
  )), '[]') into claimed
  from leased l
  join "better_supabase"."notification_recipients" rc on rc."id" = l."recipient_id"
  join "better_supabase"."notification_events" ev on ev."id" = rc."event_id"
  left join auth.users u on u.id = rc."user_id"
  left join "better_supabase"."notification_suppressions" s on s."channel" = l."channel" and s."address" = lower(u.email);
  return claimed;
end;

#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  result jsonb;
begin
  update "better_supabase"."webhook_deliveries" v
  set "status" = 'canceled', "leased_until" = null, "last_error" = 'Endpoint is disabled', "processed_at" = now(), "updated_at" = now()
  from "better_supabase"."webhook_endpoints" d
  where d."id" = v."endpoint_id"
    and not d."enabled"
    and v."status" in ('pending', 'retrying');

  update "better_supabase"."webhook_deliveries" v
  set "status" = 'dead', "leased_until" = null, "last_error" = 'The lease ran out on the last attempt', "processed_at" = now(), "updated_at" = now()
  where v."status" = 'delivering'
    and v."leased_until" <= now()
    and v."attempt" >= greatest(1, coalesce(claim_webhook_deliveries.max_attempts, 8));

  with due as (
    select v."id" as id
    from "better_supabase"."webhook_deliveries" v
    where v."status" in ('pending', 'retrying', 'delivering')
      and v."available_at" <= now()
      and (v."leased_until" is null or v."leased_until" <= now())
    order by v."available_at", v."created_at"
    for update skip locked
    limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(claim_webhook_deliveries.max_items, 25), 100))
  ),
  claimed as (
    update "better_supabase"."webhook_deliveries" v
    set "status" = 'delivering',
      "attempt" = v."attempt" + 1,
      "leased_until" = now() + coalesce(claim_webhook_deliveries.lease, '2 minutes'), "updated_at" = now()
    from due
    where v."id" = due.id
    returning v.*
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', c."id",
    'endpoint_id', c."endpoint_id",
    'type', c."event_type",
    'payload', c."payload",
    'attempt', c."attempt",
    'url', d."url",
    'created_at', c."created_at", 'tenant', c."organization_id", 'event_id', c."event_id", 'run_id', c."run_id", 'subject', c."subject", 'owner', d."created_by", 'principal', case when d."created_by" is null then "better_supabase"."default_service_principal"(d."organization_id") end, 'permissions', d."permissions", 'batch', d."batch", 'signing', d."signing", 'format', d."format", 'credential_ref', d."credential_ref"
  ) order by c."available_at"), '[]')
  into result
  from claimed c
  join "better_supabase"."webhook_endpoints" d on d."id" = c."endpoint_id";
  return result;
end;

 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  return (
    select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(s.subject_id, s.n), '{}'::jsonb)
    from (
      select c."subject_id" as subject_id, count(*) as n
      from "better_supabase"."conversations" c
      join "better_supabase"."messages" x on x."conversation_id" = c."id"
      where c."tenant_id" = comment_counts.tenant and c."kind" = 'subject'
        and c."subject_type" = comment_counts.subject_type
        and c."subject_id" = any (comment_counts.subject_ids)
        and x."sent_at" is not null and x."deleted_at" is null
      group by 1
    ) s
  );
end;

functions.name: create_invoice
functions.definition:
declare
  v_row "better_supabase"."invoices";
  v_company_type text := coalesce(create_invoice.attrs -> 'company' ->> 'type', 'company');
  v_company_id text := create_invoice.attrs -> 'company' ->> 'id';
  v_contact_type text := coalesce(create_invoice.attrs -> 'contact' ->> 'type', 'person');
  v_contact_id text := create_invoice.attrs -> 'contact' ->> 'id';
begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;
  if not ((auth.role() = 'service_role') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_invoice.tenant, 'invoices.write'), false)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to change invoices' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'INVOICE_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if nullif(trim(create_invoice.attrs ->> 'title'), '') is null then
    raise exception 'an invoice needs a title' using errcode = '23502', hint = 'INVOICE_ATTRS_INVALID';
  end if;
  if v_company_id is not null and not (case v_company_type
      when 'message' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'conversation' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."conversations" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'channel' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."channels" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'company' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."companies" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'person' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."people" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'deal' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."deals" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'engagement' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."engagements" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'work_item' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_items" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'employee' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."employees" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'product' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."products" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'product_variant' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."product_variants" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'calendar_event' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."calendar_events" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'document' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'application' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'task' then exists (select 1 from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      else false
    end and "better_supabase"."can_subject"(v_company_type, v_company_id, 'read')) then
    raise exception 'the company is unknown or not readable in this organization' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'INVOICE_COMPANY_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if v_contact_id is not null and not (case v_contact_type
      when 'message' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'conversation' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."conversations" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'channel' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."channels" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'company' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."companies" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'person' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."people" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'deal' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."deals" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'engagement' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."engagements" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'work_item' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_items" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'employee' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."employees" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'product' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."products" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'product_variant' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."product_variants" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'calendar_event' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."calendar_events" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'document' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'application' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'task' then exists (select 1 from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      else false
    end and "better_supabase"."can_subject"(v_contact_type, v_contact_id, 'read')) then
    raise exception 'the contact is unknown or not readable in this organization' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'INVOICE_CONTACT_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  begin
    insert into "better_supabase"."invoices" ("tenant_id", "title", "company_type", "company_id", "contact_type", "contact_id", "currency",
      "terms_days", "note", "origin_type", "origin_id", "deposit_bps", "created_by")
    values (create_invoice.tenant, trim(create_invoice.attrs ->> 'title'),
      case when v_company_id is null then null else v_company_type end, v_company_id,
      case when v_contact_id is null then null else v_contact_type end, v_contact_id,
      upper(coalesce(create_invoice.attrs ->> 'currency', 'EUR')), coalesce((create_invoice.attrs ->> 'termsDays')::integer, 30),
      create_invoice.attrs ->> 'note', create_invoice.attrs -> 'origin' ->> 'type', create_invoice.attrs -> 'origin' ->> 'id',
      (create_invoice.attrs ->> 'depositBps')::integer, auth.uid())
    returning * into v_row;
  exception when check_violation or invalid_text_representation then
    raise exception 'an invoice field has an invalid value' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'INVOICE_ATTRS_INVALID';
  end;
  if create_invoice.lines is not null then
    perform "better_supabase"."set_invoice_lines"(v_row."id", create_invoice.lines);
  end if;
  if v_row."origin_id" is not null then
    insert into "better_supabase"."relations" ("tenant_id", "kind", "source_type", "source_id", "target_type", "target_id", "created_by")
    select v_row."tenant_id", 'created_from', 'invoice', v_row."id"::text, v_row."origin_type", v_row."origin_id", auth.uid()
    where not exists (
      select 1 from "better_supabase"."relations" x
      where x."kind" = 'created_from' and x."source_type" = 'invoice' and x."source_id" = v_row."id"::text
    );
  end if;
  perform "better_supabase".emit_event('invoice.created', jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'invoiceId', v_row."id", 'subjectType', 'invoice', 'subjectId', v_row."id"::text, 'identifier', v_row."identifier"), 'invoices/' || v_row."id"::text, (v_row."tenant_id"::text)::text, null, 'better-supabase/invoices');
  return (select to_jsonb(x) || jsonb_build_object('number', x."number"::text, 'paid_total', x."paid_total"::text, 'credited_total', x."credited_total"::text, 'list_total', x."list_total"::text, 'discount_total', x."discount_total"::text, 'subtotal', x."subtotal"::text, 'tax_total', x."tax_total"::text, 'total', x."total"::text) || jsonb_build_object(
      'balance', (x."total" - x."credited_total" - x."paid_total")::text,
      'overdue', x."status" in ('issued', 'partially_paid') and x."due_on" < current_date,
      'lines', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('description', il."description", 'quantity', il."quantity", 'unitAmount', il."unit_amount"::text, 'discountBps', il."discount_bps", 'taxRateBps', il."tax_rate_bps", 'taxCode', il."tax_code") order by il."position") from "better_supabase"."invoice_lines" il where il."parent_id" = x."id"), '[]'::jsonb),
      'payments', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', ip."id", 'amount', ip."amount"::text, 'paidAt', ip."paid_at", 'method', ip."method", 'reference', ip."reference") order by ip."paid_at") from "better_supabase"."invoice_payments" ip where ip."invoice_id" = x."id"), '[]'::jsonb)) from "better_supabase"."invoices" x where x."id" = v_row."id");
end;

      when 'calendar_event' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."calendar_events" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'document' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'application' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      when 'task' then exists (select 1 from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (v_contact_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = create_invoice.tenant::text)
      else false
    end and "better_supabase"."can_subject"(v_contact_type, v_contact_id, 'read')) then
    raise exception 'the contact is unknown or not readable in this organization' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'INVOICE_CONTACT_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  begin
    insert into "better_supabase"."invoices" ("tenant_id", "title", "company_type", "company_id", "contact_type", "contact_id", "currency",
      "terms_days", "note", "origin_type", "origin_id", "deposit_bps", "created_by")
    values (create_invoice.tenant, trim(create_invoice.attrs ->> 'title'),
      case when v_company_id is null then null else v_company_type end, v_company_id,
      case when v_contact_id is null then null else v_contact_type end, v_contact_id,
      upper(coalesce(create_invoice.attrs ->> 'currency', 'EUR')), coalesce((create_invoice.attrs ->> 'termsDays')::integer, 30),
      create_invoice.attrs ->> 'note', create_invoice.attrs -> 'origin' ->> 'type', create_invoice.attrs -> 'origin' ->> 'id',
      (create_invoice.attrs ->> 'depositBps')::integer, auth.uid())
    returning * into v_row;
  exception when check_violation or invalid_text_representation then
    raise exception 'an invoice field has an invalid value' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'INVOICE_ATTRS_INVALID';
  end;
  if create_invoice.lines is not null then
    perform "better_supabase"."set_invoice_lines"(v_row."id", create_invoice.lines);
  end if;
  if v_row."origin_id" is not null then
    insert into "better_supabase"."relations" ("tenant_id", "kind", "source_type", "source_id", "target_type", "target_id", "created_by")
    select v_row."tenant_id", 'created_from', 'invoice', v_row."id"::text, v_row."origin_type", v_row."origin_id", auth.uid()
    where not exists (
      select 1 from "better_supabase"."relations" x
      where x."kind" = 'created_from' and x."source_type" = 'invoice' and x."source_id" = v_row."id"::text
    );
  end if;
  perform "better_supabase".emit_event('invoice.created', jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'invoiceId', v_row."id", 'subjectType', 'invoice', 'subjectId', v_row."id"::text, 'identifier', v_row."identifier"), 'invoices/' || v_row."id"::text, (v_row."tenant_id"::text)::text, null, 'better-supabase/invoices');
  return (select to_jsonb(x) || jsonb_build_object('number', x."number"::text, 'paid_total', x."paid_total"::text, 'credited_total', x."credited_total"::text, 'list_total', x."list_total"::text, 'discount_total', x."discount_total"::text, 'subtotal', x."subtotal"::text, 'tax_total', x."tax_total"::text, 'total', x."total"::text) || jsonb_build_object(
      'balance', (x."total" - x."credited_total" - x."paid_total")::text,
      'overdue', x."status" in ('issued', 'partially_paid') and x."due_on" < current_date,
      'lines', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('description', il."description", 'quantity', il."quantity", 'unitAmount', il."unit_amount"::text, 'discountBps', il."discount_bps", 'taxRateBps', il."tax_rate_bps", 'taxCode', il."tax_code") order by il."position") from "better_supabase"."invoice_lines" il where il."parent_id" = x."id"), '[]'::jsonb),
      'payments', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', ip."id", 'amount', ip."amount"::text, 'paidAt', ip."paid_at", 'method', ip."method", 'reference', ip."reference") order by ip."paid_at") from "better_supabase"."invoice_payments" ip where ip."invoice_id" = x."id"), '[]'::jsonb)) from "better_supabase"."invoices" x where x."id" = v_row."id");
end;
$function$

functions.name: create_workflow_schedule
functions.definition:
#variable_conflict use_variable
declare
  v_row "better_supabase"."workflow_schedules"%rowtype;
begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (tenant is not null and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', tenant, 'workflow.admin'), false))) then
    raise exception 'You may not schedule workflows here' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'WORKFLOW_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  insert into "better_supabase"."workflow_schedules" as x ("tenant_id", "name", "workflow", "input", "cron", "timezone", "next_run_at", "created_by")
  values (tenant, name, workflow, coalesce(payload -> 'input', '[]'::jsonb), cron, coalesce(timezone, 'UTC'), next_run, (select auth.uid()))
  on conflict on constraint workflow_schedules_tenant_name_key do update set
    "workflow" = excluded."workflow",
    "input" = excluded."input",
    "cron" = excluded."cron",
    "timezone" = excluded."timezone",
    "next_run_at" = excluded."next_run_at",
    "locked_until" = null
  returning * into v_row;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'id', v_row."id",
    'tenant', v_row."tenant_id",
    'name', v_row."name",
    'workflow', v_row."workflow",
    'input', v_row."input",
    'cron', v_row."cron",
    'timezone', v_row."timezone",
    'nextRunAt', v_row."next_run_at",
    'lastRunAt', v_row."last_run_at",
    'paused', v_row."paused",
    'createdBy', v_row."created_by",
    'createdAt', v_row."created_at"
  );
end;

    t.omit || array(

functions.name: deal_forecast
functions.definition:
with scoped as (
    select * from "better_supabase"."deals" x
    where x."tenant_id" = deal_forecast.tenant
      and x."currency" = upper(deal_forecast.currency)
      and x."archived_at" is null
      and (deal_forecast.pipeline is null or x."pipeline_id" = deal_forecast.pipeline)
      and (deal_forecast.owner is null or x."owner_user_id" = deal_forecast.owner)
  ),
  totals as (
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'won', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'won' and x."closed_at"::date >= deal_forecast.since and x."closed_at"::date <= deal_forecast.until), 0)::text,
      'commit', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'commit'), 0)::text,
      'bestCase', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'best_case'), 0)::text,
      'pipeline', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'pipeline'), 0)::text,
      'notCalled', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" is null), 0)::text,
      'omit', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'omit'), 0)::text,
      'later', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" > deal_forecast.until), 0)::text
    ) as sums
    from scoped x
  ),
  owners as (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(o.value order by o.owner_id), '[]'::jsonb) as list
    from (
      select x."owner_user_id" as owner_id, jsonb_build_object('ownerId', x."owner_user_id", 
      'won', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'won' and x."closed_at"::date >= deal_forecast.since and x."closed_at"::date <= deal_forecast.until), 0)::text,
      'commit', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'commit'), 0)::text,
      'bestCase', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'best_case'), 0)::text,
      'pipeline', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'pipeline'), 0)::text,
      'notCalled', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" is null), 0)::text,
      'omit', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'omit'), 0)::text,
      'later', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" > deal_forecast.until), 0)::text
      ) as value
      from scoped x group by x."owner_user_id"
    ) o
  )
  select totals.sums || jsonb_build_object(
    'currency', upper(deal_forecast.currency),
    'target', deal_forecast.target::text,
    'attainment', case when coalesce(deal_forecast.target, 0) = 0 then null
      else round(((totals.sums ->> 'won')::numeric + (totals.sums ->> 'commit')::numeric) / deal_forecast.target, 4) end,
    'gap', case when deal_forecast.target is null then null
      else greatest(deal_forecast.target - (totals.sums ->> 'won')::bigint - (totals.sums ->> 'commit')::bigint, 0)::text end,
    'owners', owners.list)
  from totals, owners;

begin
  return (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'dealId', x."id", 'identifier', x."identifier", 'name', x."name",
    'daysInStage', (extract(epoch from now() - coalesce(x."stage_entered_at", x."created_at")) / 86400)::integer,
    'rotting', st."rotting_after_days" is not null and now() - coalesce(x."stage_entered_at", x."created_at") > make_interval(days => st."rotting_after_days"),
    'slipped', x."push_count" > 0 or x."expected_close_on" < current_date,
    'noNextStep', x."next_at" is null and ne.e is null,
    'overdue', coalesce((x."next_at" < now() or coalesce((ne.e ->> 'overdue')::boolean, false)), false)

  from "better_supabase"."deals" x

  where x."pipeline_id" = deal_health.pipeline and x."outcome" = 'open' and x."archived_at" is null);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.default_pipeline(tenant uuid, subject_type text, scope_id text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_id uuid;
begin
  select x."id" into v_id from "better_supabase"."pipelines" x
  where x."tenant_id" = default_pipeline.tenant
    and x."subject_type" = default_pipeline.subject_type
    and x."scope_id" is not distinct from default_pipeline.scope_id
    and x."archived_at" is null
  order by x."is_default" desc, x."rank" collate "C"
  limit 1;
  if v_id is not null then
    return v_id;
  end if;
  case default_pipeline.subject_type
    when 'deal' then
      insert into "better_supabase"."pipelines" ("tenant_id", "subject_type", "scope_id", "key", "name", "is_default")
      values (default_pipeline.tenant, default_pipeline.subject_type, default_pipeline.scope_id, 'default', 'Default', true)
      on conflict do nothing
      returning "id" into v_id;
      if v_id is null then
        return "better_supabase"."default_pipeline"(default_pipeline.tenant, default_pipeline.subject_type, default_pipeline.scope_id);
      end if;
      insert into "better_supabase"."pipeline_stages" ("tenant_id", "pipeline_id", "key", "system_key", "name", "category", "outcome", "probability", "rank")
      select default_pipeline.tenant, v_id, x.key, x.key, x.name, x.category, x.outcome, x.probability, x.rank
      from (values
          ('qualified', 'Qualified', 'open', 'open', 20::smallint, '8'),
          ('discovery', 'Discovery', 'open', 'open', 35::smallint, 'G'),
          ('proposal', 'Proposal', 'open', 'open', 55::smallint, 'O'),
          ('negotiation', 'Negotiation', 'open', 'open', 75::smallint, 'W'),
          ('closed_won', 'Closed won', 'won', 'success', 100::smallint, 'e'),
          ('closed_lost', 'Closed lost', 'lost', 'failure', 0::smallint, 'm')
      ) x(key, name, category, outcome, probability, rank);
    when 'work_item' then
      insert into "better_supabase"."pipelines" ("tenant_id", "subject_type", "scope_id", "key", "name", "is_default")
      values (default_pipeline.tenant, default_pipeline.subject_type, default_pipeline.scope_id, 'default', 'Default', true)
      on conflict do nothing
      returning "id" into v_id;
      if v_id is null then
        return "better_supabase"."default_pipeline"(default_pipeline.tenant, default_pipeline.subject_type, default_pipeline.scope_id);
      end if;
      insert into "better_supabase"."pipeline_stages" ("tenant_id", "pipeline_id", "key", "system_key", "name", "category", "outcome", "probability", "rank")
      select default_pipeline.tenant, v_id, x.key, x.key, x.name, x.category, x.outcome, x.probability, x.rank
      from (values
          ('triage', 'Triage', 'triage', 'open', null::smallint, '7'),
          ('backlog', 'Backlog', 'backlog', 'open', null::smallint, 'E'),
          ('todo', 'Todo', 'unstarted', 'open', null::smallint, 'L'),
          ('in_progress', 'In progress', 'started', 'open', null::smallint, 'S'),
          ('in_review', 'In review', 'started', 'open', null::smallint, 'Z'),
          ('done', 'Done', 'completed', 'success', null::smallint, 'g'),
          ('canceled', 'Canceled', 'canceled', 'failure', null::smallint, 'n')
      ) x(key, name, category, outcome, probability, rank);
    when 'application' then
      insert into "better_supabase"."pipelines" ("tenant_id", "subject_type", "scope_id", "key", "name", "is_default")
      values (default_pipeline.tenant, default_pipeline.subject_type, default_pipeline.scope_id, 'default', 'Default', true)
      on conflict do nothing
      returning "id" into v_id;
      if v_id is null then
        return "better_supabase"."default_pipeline"(default_pipeline.tenant, default_pipeline.subject_type, default_pipeline.scope_id);
      end if;
      insert into "better_supabase"."pipeline_stages" ("tenant_id", "pipeline_id", "key", "system_key", "name", "category", "outcome", "probability", "rank")
      select default_pipeline.tenant, v_id, x.key, x.key, x.name, x.category, x.outcome, x.probability, x.rank
      from (values
          ('applied', 'Applied', 'active', 'open', null::smallint, '7'),
          ('screening', 'Screening', 'active', 'open', null::smallint, 'E'),
          ('interview', 'Interview', 'active', 'open', null::smallint, 'L'),
          ('offer', 'Offer', 'active', 'open', null::smallint, 'S'),
          ('hired', 'Hired', 'hired', 'success', null::smallint, 'Z'),
          ('rejected', 'Rejected', 'rejected', 'failure', null::smallint, 'g'),
          ('withdrawn', 'Withdrawn', 'withdrawn', 'failure', null::smallint, 'n')
      ) x(key, name, category, outcome, probability, rank);
    else
      raise exception 'this subject type has no pipeline binding' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'PIPELINE_SUBJECT_UNKNOWN';
  end case;
  return v_id;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.drive_bin(tenant uuid, page_size integer DEFAULT 50, before timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
begin
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', drive_bin.tenant, 'drive.read'), false)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to read this organization''s drive' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'DRIVE_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  return (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', b.item_id, 'batchId', b.batch_id, 'count', b.n, 'trashedBy', b.trashed_by, 'trashedAt', b.trashed_at, 'purgeAfter', b.purge_after, 'node', b.node) order by b.trashed_at desc, b.item_id), '[]'::jsonb)
    from (
      select i."id" as item_id, i."batch_id" as batch_id, i."trashed_by" as trashed_by, i."trashed_at" as trashed_at, i."purge_after" as purge_after,
        (select count(*) from "better_supabase"."trash_items" c where c."batch_id" = i."batch_id")::integer as n,
        "better_supabase"."drive_node_json"(x) as node
      from "better_supabase"."trash_items" i
      join "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" x on x."id"::text = i."subject_id"
      where i."tenant_id" = drive_bin.tenant and i."subject_type" = 'drive_node' and i."depth" = 0
        and (drive_bin.before is null or i."trashed_at" < drive_bin.before)
        and (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or "better_supabase"."drive_can"(x."id", 'editor'))
      order by i."trashed_at" desc, i."id"
      limit least(greatest(coalesce(drive_bin.page_size, 50), 1), 200)
    ) b
  );
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: tenant uuid, page_size integer DEFAULT 50, before timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone

functions.definition:
with orphans as (
    select f."id" as id from "better_supabase"."attachments" f
    where f."subject_type" = 'drive_node'
      and f."created_at" < now() - interval '1 day'
      and not exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" x where x."attachment_id" = f."id")
      and not exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."versions" r
        where r."subject_type" = 'drive_node' and r."subject_id" = f."subject_id"
          and r."content" ->> 'attachmentId' = f."id"::text
      )
    order by f."created_at"
    limit greatest(coalesce(drive_prune.max_objects, 100), 1)
  ), removed as (
    delete from "better_supabase"."attachments" f using orphans o where f."id" = o.id
    returning f."bucket" as bucket, f."object_path" as path, f."uploaded_at" as uploaded_at
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('bucket', r.bucket, 'path', r.path)) filter (where r.uploaded_at is not null), '[]'::jsonb) from removed r

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.drive_shared(tenant uuid, page_size integer DEFAULT 100)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
begin
  return (
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(("better_supabase"."drive_node_json"(c.r) || jsonb_build_object('role', "better_supabase"."drive_role"((c.r)."id"))) order by (c.r)."name", (c.r)."id"), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select x as r from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" x
    where x."tenant_id" = drive_shared.tenant and x."deleted_at" is null
      and auth.uid() is not null
      and exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_grants" dg
        where dg."node_id" = x."id" and (dg."expires_at" is null or dg."expires_at" > now())
          and ((dg."principal_type" = 'user' and dg."principal_id" = auth.uid()::text)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.due_ai_batches(batch integer DEFAULT 20, lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 300)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_rows jsonb;
begin
  with due as (
    select y."id" from "better_supabase"."ai_batches" y
    where (y."status" = 'pending' or not y."results_saved") and y."next_poll_at" <= now()
    order by y."next_poll_at"
    limit least(greatest(due_ai_batches.batch, 1), 200)
    for update skip locked
  ), claimed as (
    update "better_supabase"."ai_batches" x set
      "polls" = x."polls" + 1,
      "next_poll_at" = now() + make_interval(secs => greatest(due_ai_batches.lease_seconds, 1)),
      "updated_at" = now()
    from due where x."id" = due."id"
    returning x.*
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', claimed."id", 'organization_id', claimed."organization_id", 'user_id', claimed."user_id", 'provider', claimed."provider", 'reference', claimed."reference", 'status', claimed."status", 'raw_status', claimed."raw_status", 'item_count', claimed."item_count", 'counts', claimed."counts", 'error', claimed."error", 'metadata', claimed."metadata", 'results_saved', claimed."results_saved", 'polls', claimed."polls", 'next_poll_at', claimed."next_poll_at", 'expires_at', claimed."expires_at", 'completed_at', claimed."completed_at", 'created_at', claimed."created_at", 'updated_at', claimed."updated_at")), '[]') into v_rows from claimed;
  return v_rows;
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: batch integer DEFAULT 20, lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 300

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.expire_booking_holds_in(resource uuid, during tstzrange)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_booking "better_supabase"."bookings"%rowtype;
  v_count integer := 0;
begin
  for v_booking in
    update "better_supabase"."bookings" bk set "status" = 'cancelled', "hold_expires_at" = null, "cancelled_at" = now(), "cancel_reason" = 'expired', "updated_at" = now()
    where bk."status" = 'hold' and bk."hold_expires_at" <= now()
      and (expire_booking_holds_in.resource is null or bk."resource_id" = expire_booking_holds_in.resource)
      and (expire_booking_holds_in.during is null or bk."blocked" && expire_booking_holds_in.during)
    returning bk.*
  loop
    v_count := v_count + 1;
    perform "better_supabase".emit_event('booking.expired', jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_booking."tenant_id", 'id', v_booking."id", 'resourceId', v_booking."resource_id", 'serviceId', v_booking."service_id"), 'bookings/' || v_booking."id"::text, (v_booking."tenant_id")::text, null, 'better-supabase/bookings');
  end loop;
  return v_count;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.finish_ai_sandbox_stop(id uuid, stopped boolean, error text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_row "better_supabase"."ai_sandboxes"%rowtype;
begin
  update "better_supabase"."ai_sandboxes" x set
    "status" = case when finish_ai_sandbox_stop.stopped then 'stopped' else 'running' end,
    "stopped_at" = case when finish_ai_sandbox_stop.stopped then now() else null end,
    "error" = left(finish_ai_sandbox_stop.error, 4000),
    "updated_at" = now()
  where x."id" = finish_ai_sandbox_stop.id and x."status" = 'stopping'
  returning x.* into v_row;
  if not found then
    return false;
  end if;
  if finish_ai_sandbox_stop.stopped and v_row."harness_id" is not null then
    update "better_supabase"."ai_harness_sessions" z set "status" = 'stopped', "updated_at" = now()
    where z."chat_id" = v_row."chat_id" and z."harness_id" = v_row."harness_id"
      and z."status" in ('active', 'idle')
      and not exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."ai_sandboxes" y
        where y."chat_id" = v_row."chat_id" and y."harness_id" = v_row."harness_id" and y."status" <> 'stopped'
      );
  end if;
  return true;
end;
$function$

declare
  v_type text := field ->> 'type';
  -- required only asks for the key, so an empty answer needs its own floor.
  v_floor jsonb := case when field -> 'required' = 'true'::jsonb then '1'::jsonb end;
  v_values jsonb;
  v_out jsonb;
begin
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(o.value -> 'value' order by o.ord), '[]'::jsonb) into v_values
    from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(field -> 'options', '[]'::jsonb)) with ordinality as o(value, ord);
  v_out := case v_type
    when 'text' then jsonb_build_object('type', 'string', 'maxLength', coalesce(field -> 'maxLength', '500'::jsonb))
      || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('minLength', coalesce(field -> 'minLength', v_floor), 'pattern', field -> 'pattern'))
    when 'textarea' then jsonb_build_object('type', 'string', 'maxLength', coalesce(field -> 'maxLength', '10000'::jsonb))
      || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('minLength', coalesce(field -> 'minLength', v_floor), 'pattern', field -> 'pattern'))
    when 'email' then jsonb_build_object('type', 'string', 'format', 'email', 'maxLength', 320)
    when 'url' then jsonb_build_object('type', 'string', 'format', 'uri', 'maxLength', 2000)
    when 'number' then jsonb_build_object('type', 'number') || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('minimum', field -> 'min', 'maximum', field -> 'max'))
    when 'integer' then jsonb_build_object('type', 'integer') || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('minimum', field -> 'min', 'maximum', field -> 'max'))
    when 'date' then '{"type": "string", "format": "date"}'::jsonb
    when 'bool' then '{"type": "boolean"}'::jsonb
    when 'consent' then '{"type": "boolean", "const": true}'::jsonb
    when 'option' then jsonb_build_object('type', 'string', 'enum', v_values)
    when 'multi' then jsonb_build_object('type', 'array', 'items', jsonb_build_object('type', 'string', 'enum', v_values), 'uniqueItems', true)
      || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('minItems', coalesce(field -> 'min', v_floor), 'maxItems', field -> 'max'))
    else '{}'::jsonb
  end;
  return v_out || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('title', field -> 'label', 'description', field -> 'help'));
end;

functions.name: get_approval
functions.definition:
declare
  v_req "better_supabase"."approval_requests"%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v_req from "better_supabase"."approval_requests" r where r."id" = get_approval.request_id;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'approval request not found' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'APPROVAL_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or v_req."requested_by" = auth.uid() or "better_supabase"."approval_eligible"(v_req."id")
    or (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'approvals.read'), false) and (not v_req."subject_type" in ('ai_tool_approval') and (v_req."subject_type" in ('access_request', 'timesheet') or case v_req."subject_type"
    when 'message' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'conversation' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."conversations" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'channel' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."channels" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'company' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."companies" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'parties.read'), false)
    when 'person' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."people" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'parties.read'), false)
    when 'deal' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."deals" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'deals.read'), false)
    when 'engagement' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."engagements" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'engagements.read'), false)
    when 'work_item' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_items" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'work_items.read'), false)
    when 'employee' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."employees" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'employees.read'), false)
    when 'product' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."products" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'catalog.read'), false)
    when 'product_variant' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."product_variants" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'catalog.read'), false)
    when 'calendar_event' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."calendar_events" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'calendar.read'), false)
    when 'document' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'documents.read'), false)
    when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'customers.read'), false)
    when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'drive.read'), false)
    when 'application' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'hiring.read'), false)
    when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_req."tenant_id")
    when 'task' then exists (select 1 from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_req."tenant_id")
    else false
  end)))) then
    raise exception 'approval request not found' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'APPROVAL_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('id', v_req."id", 'organizationId', v_req."tenant_id", 'subjectType', v_req."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_req."subject_id", 'action', v_req."action", 'status', v_req."status", 'step', v_req."step", 'steps', v_req."policy" -> 'steps', 'requestedBy', v_req."requested_by", 'reason', v_req."reason", 'payload', v_req."payload", 'expiresAt', v_req."expires_at", 'decidedAt', v_req."decided_at", 'createdAt', v_req."created_at") || jsonb_build_object(
    'canDecide', "better_supabase"."approval_eligible"(v_req."id"),
    'decisions', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', x."id", 'step', x."step", 'approver', x."approver", 'decision', x."decision", 'delegateTo', x."delegate_to", 'comment', x."comment", 'createdAt', x."created_at") order by x."created_at", x."id")
      from "better_supabase"."approval_decisions" x where x."request_id" = v_req."id"
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  );
end;

functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.idle_ai_sandboxes(batch integer DEFAULT 50, lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 300)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_rows jsonb;
begin
  with due as (
    select y."id" from "better_supabase"."ai_sandboxes" y
    where ((y."status" = 'running' and (y."last_used_at" + make_interval(secs => y."idle_seconds") <= now() or y."expires_at" <= now()))
       or (y."status" = 'stopping' and y."updated_at" <= now() - make_interval(secs => greatest(idle_ai_sandboxes.lease_seconds, 1))))
      and not exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."ai_harness_sessions" z
        where z."chat_id" = y."chat_id" and z."harness_id" = y."harness_id" and z."locked_until" > now()
      )
    order by y."last_used_at"
    limit least(greatest(idle_ai_sandboxes.batch, 1), 500)
    for update skip locked
  ), claimed as (
    update "better_supabase"."ai_sandboxes" x set "status" = 'stopping', "updated_at" = now()
    from due where x."id" = due."id"
    returning x.*
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', claimed."id", 'organization_id', claimed."organization_id", 'user_id', claimed."user_id", 'chat_id', claimed."chat_id", 'harness_id', claimed."harness_id", 'provider', claimed."provider", 'sandbox_id', claimed."sandbox_id", 'container_id', claimed."container_id", 'status', claimed."status", 'metadata', claimed."metadata", 'idle_seconds', claimed."idle_seconds", 'error', claimed."error", 'last_used_at', claimed."last_used_at", 'expires_at', claimed."expires_at", 'stopped_at', claimed."stopped_at", 'created_at', claimed."created_at", 'updated_at', claimed."updated_at")), '[]') into v_rows from claimed;
  return v_rows;
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: batch integer DEFAULT 50, lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 300

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.invitation_preview(token text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  preview jsonb;
  invitation uuid;
begin
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'status', case
    when i."accepted_at" is not null then 'accepted'
    when i."declined_at" is not null then 'declined'
    when i."revoked_at" is not null then 'revoked'
    when i."expires_at" < now() then 'expired'
    else 'pending'
  end,
    'email', i."email",
    'role', i."role",
    'tenant', i."organization_id",
    'expires_at', i."expires_at",
    'organization', (select jsonb_build_object('id', o."id", 'name', o."name")
      from "public"."organizations" o where o."id" = i."organization_id"),
    'prefill', '{}'::jsonb
  ), i."id"
  into preview, invitation
  from "better_supabase"."invitations" i
  where i."token_hash" = encode(extensions.digest(invitation_preview.token, 'sha256'), 'hex');
  if preview is not null then
    preview := preview || "better_supabase"."invitation_extra"(invitation);
  end if;
  return preview;
end;
$function$

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  previous_scan text := current_setting('hnsw.iterative_scan', true);
  v_candidates integer := least(greatest(knowledge_search.k, 1) * 4, 400);
  v_scopes jsonb := case when jsonb_typeof(knowledge_search.scopes) = 'object' then knowledge_search.scopes -> 'items' else knowledge_search.scopes end;
  v_rows jsonb;
begin
  perform set_config('hnsw.iterative_scan', 'relaxed_order', true);
  with docs as materialized (
    select x."id" as id, x."title" as title from "better_supabase"."knowledge_documents" x
    where x."organization_id" = knowledge_search.tenant
      and (v_scopes is null or exists (
        select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(v_scopes) s
        where s.value ->> 'scope' = x."scope"
          and (s.value ->> 'id' is null or (s.value ->> 'id')::uuid = x."scope_id")
      ))
      and (knowledge_search.filter is null or x."metadata" @> knowledge_search.filter)
  ),
  vector_hits as materialized (
    select t."document_id" as document_id, t."idx" as idx, t."embedding" operator(extensions.<=>) knowledge_search.query_embedding as distance
    from "better_supabase"."knowledge_chunks" t
    where knowledge_search.query_embedding is not null and t."embedding" is not null
      and t."document_id" in (select docs.id from docs)
    order by t."embedding" operator(extensions.<=>) knowledge_search.query_embedding
    limit v_candidates
  ),
  vector_ranked as (
    select h.document_id, h.idx, row_number() over (order by h.distance) as rank from vector_hits h
  ),
  text_hits as materialized (
    select t."document_id" as document_id, t."idx" as idx, ts_rank_cd(t."tsv", q) as text_score
    from "better_supabase"."knowledge_chunks" t, websearch_to_tsquery('simple'::regconfig, knowledge_search.query_text) q
    where knowledge_search.query_text is not null and t."tsv" @@ q
      and t."document_id" in (select docs.id from docs)
    order by text_score desc
    limit v_candidates
  ),
  text_ranked as (
    select x.document_id, x.idx, row_number() over (order by x.text_score desc) as rank from text_hits x
  ),
  fused as (
    select coalesce(v.document_id, x.document_id) as document_id, coalesce(v.idx, x.idx) as idx,
      coalesce(1.0 / (60 + v.rank), 0) + coalesce(1.0 / (60 + x.rank), 0) as score
    from vector_ranked v full join text_ranked x on x.document_id = v.document_id and x.idx = v.idx
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('document_id', r.document_id, 'idx', r.idx, 'content', r.content, 'metadata', r.metadata, 'title', r.title, 'score', r.score) order by r.score desc, r.document_id, r.idx), '[]')
  into v_rows
  from (
    select f.document_id, f.idx, t."content" as content, t."metadata" as metadata, docs.title, f.score
    from fused f
    join "better_supabase"."knowledge_chunks" t on t."document_id" = f.document_id and t."idx" = f.idx
    join docs on docs.id = f.document_id
    order by f.score desc, f.document_id, f.idx
    limit least(greatest(knowledge_search.k, 1), 100)
  ) r;
  perform set_config('hnsw.iterative_scan', coalesce(previous_scan, 'off'), true);
  return v_rows;
end;
$function$

select coalesce(jsonb_agg(item order by created desc), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select jsonb_build_object('id', r."id", 'organizationId', r."tenant_id", 'userId', r."user_id", 'role', r."role", 'previousRole', r."previous_role", 'reason', r."reason", 'duration', r."duration"::text, 'status', case when r."ended_at" is not null then 'ended' when r."granted_at" is not null then 'granted' else coalesce(x."status", 'pending') end, 'approvalId', r."approval_id", 'grantedAt', r."granted_at", 'expiresAt', r."expires_at", 'endedAt', r."ended_at", 'createdAt', r."created_at") as item, r."created_at" as created
    from "better_supabase"."access_requests" r
    left join "better_supabase"."approval_requests" x on x."id" = r."approval_id"
    where r."tenant_id" = list_access_requests.tenant
      and (r."user_id" = auth.uid() or (not list_access_requests.mine and (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', list_access_requests.tenant, 'access_requests.read'), false))))
      and (list_access_requests.status is null or case when r."ended_at" is not null then 'ended' when r."granted_at" is not null then 'granted' else coalesce(x."status", 'pending') end = list_access_requests.status)
      and (list_access_requests.before is null or r."created_at" < list_access_requests.before)
    order by r."created_at" desc
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(list_access_requests.page_size, 50), 1), 200)
  ) items

functions.name: list_activity
functions.definition:
declare
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(list_activity.max_rows, 50), 1), 500);
  v_rows jsonb;
  v_table text;
begin
  if list_activity.subject_id is not null and list_activity.subject_type = any ('{message,conversation,channel,company,person,deal,engagement,work_item,employee,product,product_variant,calendar_event,document,customer,drive_node,application,project,task}'::text[])
    and not "better_supabase"."activity_subject_readable"(list_activity.subject_type, list_activity.subject_id) then
    return '[]'::jsonb;
  end if;
  if list_activity.subject_id is not null then
    v_table := case list_activity.subject_type
      when 'message' then 'better_supabase.messages'
      when 'conversation' then 'better_supabase.conversations'
      when 'channel' then 'better_supabase.channels'
      when 'company' then 'better_supabase.companies'
      when 'person' then 'better_supabase.people'
      when 'deal' then 'better_supabase.deals'
      when 'engagement' then 'better_supabase.engagements'
      when 'work_item' then 'better_supabase.work_items'
      when 'employee' then 'better_supabase.employees'
      when 'product' then 'better_supabase.products'
      when 'product_variant' then 'better_supabase.product_variants'
      when 'calendar_event' then 'better_supabase.calendar_events'
      when 'document' then 'better_supabase.documents'
      when 'customer' then 'public.customers'
      when 'drive_node' then 'better_supabase.drive_nodes'
      when 'application' then 'better_supabase.applications'
      when 'project' then 'public.projects'
      when 'task' then 'public.tasks'
    end;
  end if;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.entry order by x.at desc, x.id desc), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_rows
  from (
    select u.entry, u.at, u.id from (
    (select to_jsonb(y.*) || jsonb_build_object('source', 'event') as entry,
      y."occurred_at" as at, y."id"::text as id
    from "better_supabase"."activity_entries" y
    where y."organization_id" = list_activity.tenant
      and (list_activity.sources is null or 'event' = any (list_activity.sources))
      and (list_activity.subject_type is null or y."subject_type" = list_activity.subject_type)
      and (list_activity.subject_id is null or y."subject_id" = list_activity.subject_id)
      and (list_activity.before is null or y."occurred_at" < list_activity.before)
    order by y."occurred_at" desc, y."id" desc
    limit v_limit)
    union all
    (select jsonb_build_object('id', l."id"::text, 'organization_id', l."organization_id", 'event_id', null::text, 'type', coalesce(l."event_type", 'audit.' || l."op"), 'actor_id', l."actor_id", 'subject_type', list_activity.subject_type, 'subject_id', list_activity.subject_id, 'summary', l."summary", 'data', jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('op', l."op", 'changed', to_jsonb(l."changed"), 'table', l."table_name")), 'occurred_at', l."occurred_at", 'source', 'audit') as entry,
      l."occurred_at" as at, l."id"::text as id
    from "better_supabase"."audit_events" l
    where v_table is not null
      and (list_activity.sources is null or 'audit' = any (list_activity.sources))
      and l."table_name" = v_table
      and l."record_id" = list_activity.subject_id
      and l."organization_id" = list_activity.tenant
      and (list_activity.before is null or l."occurred_at" < list_activity.before)
    order by l."occurred_at" desc, l."id" desc
    limit v_limit)
    union all
    (select jsonb_build_object('id', r."id"::text, 'organization_id', r."tenant_id", 'event_id', null::text, 'type', 'run.' || r."status", 'actor_id', r."actor_id", 'subject_type', list_activity.subject_type, 'subject_id', list_activity.subject_id, 'summary', null::text, 'data', jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('runId', r."id", 'definition', r."definition", 'engine', r."engine", 'status', r."status", 'mode', r."mode", 'error', r."error"::text, 'completedAt', r."completed_at")), 'occurred_at', r."created_at", 'source', 'run') as entry,
      r."created_at" as at, r."id"::text as id
    from "better_supabase"."workflow_runs" r
    where list_activity.subject_id is not null
      and list_activity.subject_type = any ('{message,conversation,channel,company,person,deal,engagement,work_item,employee,product,product_variant,calendar_event,document,customer,drive_node,application,project,task}'::text[])
      and (list_activity.sources is null or 'run' = any (list_activity.sources))
      and r."tenant_id" = list_activity.tenant
      and r."subject_type" = list_activity.subject_type
      and r."subject_id" = list_activity.subject_id
      and (list_activity.before is null or r."created_at" < list_activity.before)
    order by r."created_at" desc, r."id" desc
    limit v_limit)
    union all
    (select d.entry, d.at, d.id
    from "better_supabase"."activity_subject_deliveries"(list_activity.tenant, list_activity.subject_type, list_activity.subject_id, list_activity.before, v_limit) d
    where list_activity.subject_id is not null
      and (list_activity.sources is null or 'delivery' = any (list_activity.sources)))
    ) u
    order by u.at desc, u.id desc
    limit v_limit
  ) x;
  return v_rows;
end;
