functions.name: list_agents
functions.definition:
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(y.row order by y.at desc), '[]')
  from (
    select jsonb_build_object('id', x."id", 'organization_id', x."organization_id", 'owner_id', x."owner_id", 'slug', x."slug", 'name', x."name", 'description', x."description", 'instructions', x."instructions", 'model', x."model", 'tools', x."tools", 'connector_ids', x."connector_ids", 'knowledge_scope', x."knowledge_scope", 'starters', x."starters", 'visibility', x."visibility", 'published_at', x."published_at", 'install_count', x."install_count", 'rating_count', x."rating_count", 'rating_sum', x."rating_sum", 'created_at', x."created_at", 'updated_at', x."updated_at") || jsonb_build_object('installed', exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."agent_installs" n where n."agent_id" = x."id" and n."user_id" = auth.uid() and n."organization_id" = list_agents.tenant)) as row,
      coalesce(x."published_at", x."updated_at") as at
    from "better_supabase"."agents" x
    where case list_agents.filter
        when 'mine' then x."owner_id" = auth.uid() and x."organization_id" = list_agents.tenant
        when 'installed' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."agent_installs" n where n."agent_id" = x."id" and n."user_id" = auth.uid() and n."organization_id" = list_agents.tenant)
        else x."published_at" is not null and (x."visibility" = 'public' or x."organization_id" = list_agents.tenant)
      end
      and (list_agents.search is null or x."name" ilike '%' || replace(replace(list_agents.search, '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%'
        or x."description" ilike '%' || replace(replace(list_agents.search, '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%')
    order by coalesce(x."published_at", x."updated_at") desc
    limit least(greatest(list_agents.max_rows, 1), 200)
  ) y

      when k."expires_at" is not null and k."expires_at" <= now() then 'expired'
      when k."revoked_at" is not null then 'grace'

    'id', k."id",

functions.name: list_channels
functions.definition:
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) || jsonb_build_object(
      'archivedAt', c."archived_at",
      'lastMessageAt', c."last_message_at",
      'role', (select k."role" from "better_supabase"."conversation_members" k where k."conversation_id" = c."id" and k."user_id" = auth.uid()),
      'memberCount', (select count(*) from "better_supabase"."conversation_members" k where k."conversation_id" = c."id")
    ) order by x."name"), '[]'::jsonb)
  from "better_supabase"."channels" x
  join "better_supabase"."conversations" c on c."id" = x."id"
  where x."tenant_id" = list_channels.tenant
    and (list_channels.include_archived or c."archived_at" is null)
    and (list_channels.browse or exists (
      select 1 from "better_supabase"."conversation_members" k where k."conversation_id" = x."id" and k."user_id" = auth.uid()
    ))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.list_companies(tenant uuid, search text, lifecycle text, owner uuid, after_name text, after_id uuid, page_size integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_like text := '%' || replace(replace(replace(coalesce(list_companies.search, ''), '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%';
begin
  return coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) order by lower(p."name"), p."id")
    from (
      select x.* from "better_supabase"."companies" x
      where x."tenant_id" = list_companies.tenant
        and x."archived_at" is null
        and (list_companies.search is null or x."name" ilike v_like or x."domain" ilike v_like)
        and (list_companies.lifecycle is null or x."lifecycle" = list_companies.lifecycle)
        and (list_companies.owner is null or x."owner_user_id" = list_companies.owner)
        and (list_companies.after_name is null or (lower(x."name"), x."id") > (lower(list_companies.after_name), list_companies.after_id))
      order by lower(x."name"), x."id"
      limit least(greatest(coalesce(list_companies.page_size, 50), 1), 200)
    ) p
  ), '[]'::jsonb);
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: tenant uuid, search text, lifecycle text, owner uuid, after_name text, after_id uuid, page_size integer
functions.identity_argument_types: tenant uuid, search text, lifecycle text, owner uuid, after_name text, after_id uuid, page_size integer

functions.name: list_conversations
functions.definition:
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    to_jsonb(c) || jsonb_build_object(
      'unread', u.unread,
      'mentions', u.mentions,
      'lastReadAt', k."last_read_at",
      'notify', k."notify"
    ) order by c."last_message_at" desc nulls last, c."id"), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select c.* from "better_supabase"."conversations" c
    join "better_supabase"."conversation_members" k on k."conversation_id" = c."id" and k."user_id" = auth.uid()
    where c."tenant_id" = list_conversations.tenant
      and (list_conversations.kinds is null or c."kind" = any (list_conversations.kinds))
    order by c."last_message_at" desc nulls last, c."id"
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(list_conversations.max_rows, 100), 1), 500)
  ) c
  join "better_supabase"."conversation_members" k on k."conversation_id" = c."id" and k."user_id" = auth.uid()
  cross join lateral (
    select count(*) as unread,
      count(*) filter (where auth.uid() = any (m."mentions") or m."mention_scope" is not null) as mentions
    from "better_supabase"."messages" m
    where m."conversation_id" = c."id"
      and (m."thread_id" is null or m."broadcast")
      and m."sent_at" > coalesce(k."last_read_at", '-infinity'::timestamptz)
      and m."deleted_at" is null
      and m."author_id" is distinct from auth.uid()
  ) u
functions.complete_statement:

functions.name: list_document_versions
functions.definition:
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_doc "better_supabase"."documents"%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v_doc from "better_supabase"."documents" d where d."id" = list_document_versions.document_id;
  if not found or not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'documents.read'), false) and case v_doc."subject_type"
    when 'message' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'conversation' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."conversations" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'channel' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."channels" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'company' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."companies" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'parties.read'), false)
    when 'person' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."people" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'parties.read'), false)
    when 'deal' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."deals" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'deals.read'), false)
    when 'engagement' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."engagements" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'engagements.read'), false)
    when 'work_item' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_items" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'work_items.read'), false)
    when 'employee' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."employees" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'employees.read'), false)
    when 'product' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."products" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'catalog.read'), false)
    when 'product_variant' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."product_variants" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'catalog.read'), false)
    when 'calendar_event' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."calendar_events" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'calendar.read'), false)
    when 'document' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'documents.read'), false)
    when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'customers.read'), false)
    when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'drive.read'), false)
    when 'application' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'hiring.read'), false)
    when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id")
    when 'task' then exists (select 1 from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id")
    else false
  end)) then
    raise exception 'document not found' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  return (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', x."id", 'number', x."number", 'label', x."label", 'createdBy', x."created_by", 'createdAt', x."created_at") order by x."number" desc), '[]'::jsonb)
    from "better_supabase"."versions" x
    where x."subject_type" = 'document' and x."subject_id" = v_doc."id"::text
  );
end;

    when 'calendar_event' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."calendar_events" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'calendar.read'), false)
    when 'document' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'documents.read'), false)
    when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'customers.read'), false)
    when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'drive.read'), false)
    when 'application' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'hiring.read'), false)
    when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id")
    when 'task' then exists (select 1 from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id")
    else false
  end)) then
    raise exception 'document not found' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  return (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', x."id", 'number', x."number", 'label', x."label", 'createdBy', x."created_by", 'createdAt', x."created_at") order by x."number" desc), '[]'::jsonb)
    from "better_supabase"."versions" x
    where x."subject_type" = 'document' and x."subject_id" = v_doc."id"::text
  );
end;
$function$

functions.definition:
select coalesce(jsonb_agg("better_supabase"."inbox_conversation_json"(page."id") || jsonb_build_object('unread', page.unread) order by page."last_message_at" desc, page."id" desc), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select v."id", v."last_message_at",
      v."last_message_at" > coalesce((select r."last_read_at" from "better_supabase"."conversation_reads" r where r."conversation_id" = v."id" and r."user_id" = (select auth.uid())), '-infinity'::timestamptz) as unread
    from "better_supabase"."inbox_conversations" v
    left join "better_supabase"."contacts" c on c."id" = v."contact_id"
    where (list_inbox_conversations.tenant is null or v."tenant_id" = list_inbox_conversations.tenant)
      and (filter ->> 'inbox_id' is null or v."inbox_id" = (filter ->> 'inbox_id')::uuid)
      and (coalesce(filter ->> 'status', 'open') = 'all' or v."status" = coalesce(filter ->> 'status', 'open'))
      and (case filter ->> 'assignee'
        when 'me' then v."assignee_id" = (select auth.uid())
        when 'unassigned' then v."assignee_id" is null
        else filter ->> 'assignee' is null or v."assignee_id" = (filter ->> 'assignee')::uuid end)
      and (filter ->> 'team_id' is null or v."team_id" = (filter ->> 'team_id')::uuid)
      and (filter ->> 'contact_id' is null or v."contact_id" = (filter ->> 'contact_id')::uuid)
      and (nullif(filter ->> 'search', '') is null
        or v."subject" ilike '%' || (filter ->> 'search') || '%'
        or v."last_message_preview" ilike '%' || (filter ->> 'search') || '%'
        or c."name" ilike '%' || (filter ->> 'search') || '%'
        or c."email" ilike '%' || (filter ->> 'search') || '%')
      and (filter -> 'before' is null
        or (v."last_message_at", v."id") < ((filter -> 'before' ->> 'last_message_at')::timestamptz, (filter -> 'before' ->> 'id')::uuid))
    order by v."last_message_at" desc, v."id" desc
    limit least(greatest(coalesce((filter ->> 'limit')::integer, 50), 1), 200)
  ) page;

functions.name: list_inbox_messages
functions.definition:
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(page.item order by page.created_at, page.id), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select m."created_at" as created_at, m."id" as id,
      to_jsonb(m) || jsonb_build_object('delivery', (
        select jsonb_build_object('status', d."status", 'channel', d."channel", 'error', d."error", 'updated_at', d."updated_at")
        from "better_supabase"."message_deliveries" d where d."message_id" = m."id"
        order by d."created_at" limit 1
      )) as item
    from "better_supabase"."inbox_messages" m
    where m."conversation_id" = list_inbox_messages.conversation
      and (before is null or m."created_at" < before)
    order by m."created_at" desc, m."id" desc
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(max, 50), 1), 200)
  ) page;

functions.name: list_notifications
functions.definition:
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.item order by x.created_at desc, x.id desc), '[]')
  from (
    select jsonb_build_object('id', rc."id", 'event_id', ev."id", 'type', ev."type", 'data', ev."data", 'created_at', rc."created_at", 'read_at', rc."read_at", 'tenant', ev."organization_id", 'actor_id', ev."actor_id", 'subject_type', ev."subject_type", 'subject_id', ev."subject_id", 'subject_label', ev."subject_label", 'summary', ev."summary", 'action_path', ev."action_path", 'priority', ev."priority", 'resolved_at', rc."resolved_at") as item, rc."created_at" as created_at, rc."id" as id
    from "better_supabase"."notification_recipients" rc
    join "better_supabase"."notification_events" ev on ev."id" = rc."event_id"
    where rc."user_id" = auth.uid()
      and case when coalesce(list_notifications.status, 'all') = 'settled' then (rc."resolved_at" is not null or rc."dismissed_at" is not null) when list_notifications.dismissed is null then true else (rc."dismissed_at" is not null) = list_notifications.dismissed end
      and (list_notifications.read is null or (rc."read_at" is not null) = list_notifications.read)
      and (list_notifications.resolved is null or (rc."resolved_at" is not null) = list_notifications.resolved)
      and (list_notifications.tenant is null or rc."organization_id" = list_notifications.tenant)
      and (list_notifications.types is null or ev."type" = any(list_notifications.types))
      and (list_notifications.subject_types is null or ev."subject_type" = any(list_notifications.subject_types))
      and (list_notifications.search is null or btrim(list_notifications.search) = '' or concat_ws(' ', ev."summary", ev."subject_label", ev."type") ilike '%' || replace(replace(replace(btrim(list_notifications.search), chr(92), chr(92) || chr(92)), '%', chr(92) || '%'), '_', chr(92) || '_') || '%')
      and case coalesce(list_notifications.status, 'all')
        when 'unread' then rc."read_at" is null
        when 'read' then rc."read_at" is not null
        when 'unresolved' then rc."resolved_at" is null
        else true
      end
      and (
        list_notifications.before is null
        or (rc."created_at", rc."id") < (list_notifications.before, coalesce(list_notifications.before_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid))
      )
    order by rc."created_at" desc, rc."id" desc
    limit least(coalesce(list_notifications.max_items, 50), 200)
  ) x

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.list_people(tenant uuid, search text, lifecycle text, owner uuid, after_name text, after_id uuid, page_size integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_like text := '%' || replace(replace(replace(coalesce(list_people.search, ''), '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%';
begin
  return coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) order by lower(p."name"), p."id")
    from (
      select x.* from "better_supabase"."people" x
      where x."tenant_id" = list_people.tenant
        and x."archived_at" is null
        and (list_people.search is null or x."name" ilike v_like or x."email" ilike v_like)
        and (list_people.lifecycle is null or x."lifecycle" = list_people.lifecycle)

        and (list_people.after_name is null or (lower(x."name"), x."id") > (lower(list_people.after_name), list_people.after_id))
      order by lower(x."name"), x."id"
      limit least(greatest(coalesce(list_people.page_size, 50), 1), 200)
    ) p
  ), '[]'::jsonb);
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.list_trash(tenant uuid, subject_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, page_size integer DEFAULT 50, before timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_rows jsonb;
begin
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', list_trash.tenant, 'trash.read'), false)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to read this organization''s trash' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'TRASH_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', t."id", 'subjectType', t."subject_type", 'subjectId', t."subject_id", 'title', t."title", 'batchId', t."batch_id", 'count', t.n, 'trashedBy', t."trashed_by", 'trashedAt', t."trashed_at", 'purgeAfter', t."purge_after") order by t."trashed_at" desc, t."id"), '[]'::jsonb)
    into v_rows
  from (
    select x.*, (select count(*) from "better_supabase"."trash_items" b where b."batch_id" = x."batch_id")::integer as n
    from "better_supabase"."trash_items" x
    where x."tenant_id" = list_trash.tenant
      and x."depth" = 0
      and (list_trash.subject_type is null or x."subject_type" = list_trash.subject_type)
      and (list_trash.before is null or x."trashed_at" < list_trash.before)
      and (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or case x."subject_type"
    when 'message' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (x."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = x."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', x."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'conversation' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."conversations" s where s."id" = (x."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = x."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', x."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'deal' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."deals" s where s."id" = (x."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = x."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', x."tenant_id", 'deals.read'), false)
    when 'work_item' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_items" s where s."id" = (x."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = x."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', x."tenant_id", 'work_items.read'), false)
    when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (x."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = x."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', x."tenant_id", 'customers.read'), false)
    when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (x."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = x."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', x."tenant_id", 'drive.read'), false)
    when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (x."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = x."tenant_id")
    else false
  end)
    order by x."trashed_at" desc, x."id"
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(list_trash.page_size, 50), 1), 200)
  ) t;
  return v_rows;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.list_versions(tenant uuid, subject_type text, subject_id text, page_size integer DEFAULT 50, before integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_rows jsonb;
begin
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', list_versions.tenant, 'versions.read'), false) and case list_versions.subject_type
    when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (list_versions.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = list_versions.tenant)
    when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (list_versions.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = list_versions.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', list_versions.tenant, 'customers.read'), false)
    else false
  end)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to read these versions' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'VERSION_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', v."id", 'number', v."number", 'label', v."label", 'source', v."source", 'frozen', v."frozen", 'contentHash', v."content_hash", 'storagePath', v."storage_path", 'subjectType', v."subject_type", 'subjectId', v."subject_id", 'createdBy', v."created_by", 'createdAt', v."created_at") order by v."number" desc), '[]'::jsonb) into v_rows
  from (
    select * from "better_supabase"."versions" x
    where x."tenant_id" = list_versions.tenant
      and x."subject_type" = list_versions.subject_type
      and x."subject_id" = list_versions.subject_id
      and (list_versions.before is null or x."number" < list_versions.before)
    order by x."number" desc
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(list_versions.page_size, 50), 1), 200)
  ) v;
  return v_rows;
end;
$function$

select coalesce(jsonb_agg(p.value order by p.number desc), '[]'::jsonb)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.move_cart_codes(p_from uuid, p_to uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER

AS $function$
declare
  v_count integer;
begin
  insert into "better_supabase"."cart_promotion_codes" ("tenant_id", "cart_id", "code_id")

  from "better_supabase"."cart_promotion_codes" x

    and not exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."cart_promotion_codes" y where y."cart_id" = p_to and y."code_id" = x."code_id")

  limit greatest(5 - (select count(*) from "better_supabase"."cart_promotion_codes" y where y."cart_id" = p_to), 0);
  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
  delete from "better_supabase"."cart_promotion_codes" x where x."cart_id" = p_from;
  return v_count;
end;
$function$

with matched as (
    select jsonb_build_object('id', rc."id", 'event_id', ev."id", 'type', ev."type", 'data', ev."data", 'created_at', rc."created_at", 'read_at', rc."read_at", 'tenant', ev."organization_id", 'actor_id', ev."actor_id", 'subject_type', ev."subject_type", 'subject_id', ev."subject_id", 'subject_label', ev."subject_label", 'summary', ev."summary", 'action_path', ev."action_path", 'priority', ev."priority", 'resolved_at', rc."resolved_at") as item, rc."created_at" as created_at, rc."id" as id
    from "better_supabase"."notification_recipients" rc
    join "better_supabase"."notification_events" ev on ev."id" = rc."event_id"
    where rc."user_id" = auth.uid()
      and case when coalesce(notification_page.status, 'all') = 'settled' then (rc."resolved_at" is not null or rc."dismissed_at" is not null) when notification_page.dismissed is null then true else (rc."dismissed_at" is not null) = notification_page.dismissed end
      and (notification_page.read is null or (rc."read_at" is not null) = notification_page.read)
      and (notification_page.resolved is null or (rc."resolved_at" is not null) = notification_page.resolved)
      and (notification_page.tenant is null or rc."organization_id" = notification_page.tenant)
      and (notification_page.types is null or ev."type" = any(notification_page.types))
      and (notification_page.subject_types is null or ev."subject_type" = any(notification_page.subject_types))
      and (notification_page.search is null or btrim(notification_page.search) = '' or concat_ws(' ', ev."summary", ev."subject_label", ev."type") ilike '%' || replace(replace(replace(btrim(notification_page.search), chr(92), chr(92) || chr(92)), '%', chr(92) || '%'), '_', chr(92) || '_') || '%')
      and case coalesce(notification_page.status, 'all')
        when 'unread' then rc."read_at" is null
        when 'read' then rc."read_at" is not null
        when 'unresolved' then rc."resolved_at" is null
        else true
      end
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'items', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(p.item order by p.created_at desc, p.id desc)
      from (
        select m.item, m.created_at, m.id from matched m
        order by m.created_at desc, m.id desc
        offset greatest(coalesce(notification_page.skip, 0), 0)
        limit least(greatest(coalesce(notification_page.max_items, 50), 1), 200)
      ) p
    ), '[]'),
    'total', (select count(*) from matched)
  )

  v_write := coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'documents.write'), false) and case v_doc."subject_type"
    when 'message' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)

    when 'company' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."companies" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'parties.read'), false)

    when 'product' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."products" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'catalog.read'), false)
    when 'product_variant' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."product_variants" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'catalog.read'), false)

    when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'customers.read'), false)
    when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'drive.read'), false)
    when 'application' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'hiring.read'), false)
    when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id")

  end and case v_doc."subject_type"

    when 'person' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'parties.write'), false)
    when 'deal' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'deals.write'), false)
    when 'engagement' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'engagements.write'), false)
    when 'work_item' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'work_items.write'), false)
    when 'employee' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'employees.write'), false)
    when 'product' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'catalog.manage'), false)
    when 'product_variant' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'catalog.manage'), false)
    when 'calendar_event' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'calendar.write'), false)
    when 'document' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'documents.write'), false)
    when 'customer' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'customers.write'), false)
    when 'drive_node' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'drive.manage'), false)
    when 'application' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'hiring.write'), false)
    else true
  end);
  select * into v_snapshot from "better_supabase"."document_snapshots" x where x."document_id" = v_doc."id";

    'snapshot', case when v_snapshot."document_id" is null then null else replace(encode(v_snapshot."state", 'base64'), E'\n', '') end,
    'snapshotSeq', coalesce(v_snapshot."seq", 0),
    'updates', "better_supabase"."document_updates_after"(v_doc."id", coalesce(v_snapshot."seq", 0))
  );

select coalesce(jsonb_agg(p.value order by p.due nulls last, p.id), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select to_jsonb(x) || jsonb_build_object('subjects', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('type', sx."subject_type", 'id', sx."subject_id") order by sx."position") from "better_supabase"."engagement_subjects" sx where sx."engagement_id" = x."id"), '[]'::jsonb), 'overdue', x."done_at" is null and x."due_at" < now()) as value, x."due_at" as due, x."id" as id
    from "better_supabase"."engagements" x
    where x."tenant_id" = open_engagements.tenant
      and x."owner_user_id" = coalesce(open_engagements.owner, auth.uid())
      and x."done_at" is null
      and (open_engagements.due_before is null or x."due_at" < open_engagements.due_before)
    order by x."due_at" nulls last, x."id"
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(open_engagements.page_size, 50), 1), 200)
  ) p

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.order_transition(p_order uuid, p_to text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_from text;
begin
  select x."status" into v_from from "better_supabase"."orders" x where x."id" = p_order for update;
  if v_from = p_to then
    return v_from;
  end if;
  if not (case v_from
    when 'pending_payment' then p_to = any ('{paid,cancelled}'::text[])
    when 'paid' then p_to = any ('{fulfilled,refunded}'::text[])
    when 'fulfilled' then p_to = any ('{paid,completed,refunded}'::text[])
    when 'completed' then p_to = any ('{refunded}'::text[])
    when 'cancelled' then p_to = any ('{}'::text[])
    when 'refunded' then p_to = any ('{}'::text[])
    else false end) then
    raise exception 'the order can''t move to this status' using errcode = '55000', hint = 'ORDERS_TRANSITION_INVALID';
  end if;
  update "better_supabase"."orders" x set "status" = p_to, "updated_at" = now(),
    "paid_at" = case when p_to = 'paid' then coalesce(x."paid_at", now()) else x."paid_at" end,
    "fulfilled_at" = case when p_to = 'fulfilled' then now() when p_to = 'paid' then null else x."fulfilled_at" end,
    "completed_at" = case when p_to = 'completed' then now() else x."completed_at" end,
    "cancelled_at" = case when p_to = 'cancelled' then now() else x."cancelled_at" end
  where x."id" = p_order;
  return v_from;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.org_chart(tenant uuid, root uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not ((auth.role() = 'service_role') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', org_chart.tenant, 'employees.read'), false) or (org_chart.root is not null and exists (
    with recursive up (id, manager) as (
      select u."id", u."manager_id" from "better_supabase"."employees" u where u."id" = org_chart.root
      union
      select u."id", u."manager_id" from "better_supabase"."employees" u join up on u."id" = up.manager
    )
    select 1 from up join "better_supabase"."employees" me on me."id" = up.id where me."user_id" = auth.uid()))) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to read the org chart' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'EMPLOYEE_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  return (
    with recursive tree (id, depth, path) as (
      select x."id", 0, array[lower(x."name"), x."id"::text]
      from "better_supabase"."employees" x
      where x."tenant_id" = org_chart.tenant and x."status" <> 'offboarded'
        and case when org_chart.root is null then x."manager_id" is null else x."id" = org_chart.root end
      union all
      select c."id", tree.depth + 1, tree.path || array[lower(c."name"), c."id"::text]
      from "better_supabase"."employees" c join tree on c."manager_id" = tree.id
      where c."status" <> 'offboarded' and tree.depth < 100
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) || jsonb_build_object('depth', tree.depth, 'direct_reports', (select count(*) from "better_supabase"."employees" r where r."manager_id" = x."id" and r."status" <> 'offboarded')) order by tree.path), '[]'::jsonb)
    from tree join "better_supabase"."employees" x on x."id" = tree.id
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.outbox_claim(consumer text, owner text, max_events integer DEFAULT 100, lease interval DEFAULT '00:01:00'::interval)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_variable
declare
  c "better_supabase"."outbox_consumers";
  events jsonb;
begin
  update "better_supabase"."outbox_consumers" k
  set "lease_owner" = owner, "lease_until" = now() + lease, "updated_at" = now()
  where k."name" = consumer
    and (k."lease_until" is null or k."lease_until" < now() or k."lease_owner" = owner)
    and (k."retry_at" is null or k."retry_at" <= now())
  returning k.* into c;
  if not found then
    if not exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."outbox_consumers" k where k."name" = consumer) then
      raise exception 'Unknown outbox consumer %', consumer using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'OUTBOX_UNKNOWN_CONSUMER';
    end if;
    return '[]';
  end if;
  select jsonb_agg(x.event order by x.n) into events
  from (
    select jsonb_build_object(
    'position', e."position",
    'id', e."id",
    'type', e."type",
    'payload', e."payload",
    'created_at', e."created_at",
    'source', e."source",
    'subject', e."subject",
    'tenant', e."organization_id",
    'key', e."key",
    'actor_id', e."actor_id"
  ) as event, row_number() over (order by e."xid", e."position") as n
    from "better_supabase"."outbox_events" e
    where (e."xid", e."position") > (c."cursor_xid", c."cursor_position")
      and e."xid" < pg_snapshot_xmin(pg_current_snapshot())
      and (c."types" is null or exists (
        select 1 from unnest(c."types") p
        where p = '*' or p = e."type"
          or (right(p, 2) = '.*' and starts_with(e."type", left(p, -1)))
      ))
    order by e."xid", e."position"
    limit case when c."attempts" > 0 then 1 else max_events end
  ) x;
  if events is null then
    update "better_supabase"."outbox_consumers" k
    set ("cursor_xid", "cursor_position") = (
      select e."xid", e."position" from "better_supabase"."outbox_events" e
      where (e."xid", e."position") > (c."cursor_xid", c."cursor_position") and e."xid" < pg_snapshot_xmin(pg_current_snapshot())
      order by e."xid" desc, e."position" desc
      limit 1
    )
    where k."name" = consumer
      and exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."outbox_events" e where (e."xid", e."position") > (c."cursor_xid", c."cursor_position") and e."xid" < pg_snapshot_xmin(pg_current_snapshot()));
  end if;
  return coalesce(events, '[]');
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: consumer text, owner text, max_events integer DEFAULT 100, lease interval DEFAULT '00:01:00'::interval
functions.identity_argument_types: consumer text, owner text, max_events integer, lease interval

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.outbox_fail(consumer text, owner text, failed bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint, error text DEFAULT NULL::text, max_attempts integer DEFAULT 10, max_backoff interval DEFAULT '00:10:00'::interval)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_variable
declare
  c "better_supabase"."outbox_consumers";
begin
  update "better_supabase"."outbox_consumers" k
  set "attempts" = k."attempts" + 1, "last_error" = left(error, 4000),
    "lease_owner" = null, "lease_until" = null, "updated_at" = now()
  where k."name" = consumer and k."lease_owner" = owner
  returning k.* into c;
  if not found then
    return null;
  end if;
  if failed is not null and c."attempts" >= greatest(coalesce(max_attempts, 10), 1) then
    insert into "better_supabase"."outbox_dead_letters" ("consumer", "position", "event_id", "type", "event", "attempts", "error")
    select consumer, e."position", e."id"::text, e."type", jsonb_build_object(
    'position', e."position",
    'id', e."id",
    'type', e."type",
    'payload', e."payload",
    'created_at', e."created_at",
    'source', e."source",
    'subject', e."subject",
    'tenant', e."organization_id",
    'key', e."key",
    'actor_id', e."actor_id"
  ), c."attempts", c."last_error"
    from "better_supabase"."outbox_events" e
    where e."position" = failed and (e."xid", e."position") > (c."cursor_xid", c."cursor_position")
    on conflict do nothing;
    update "better_supabase"."outbox_consumers" k
    set ("cursor_xid", "cursor_position") = (
        select e."xid", e."position" from "better_supabase"."outbox_events" e where e."position" = failed
      ),
      "attempts" = 0, "retry_at" = null
    where k."name" = consumer
      and exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."outbox_events" e where e."position" = failed and (e."xid", e."position") > (k."cursor_xid", k."cursor_position"));
    if found then
      return 'dead';
    end if;
  end if;
  update "better_supabase"."outbox_consumers" k
  set "retry_at" = now() + least(
    coalesce(max_backoff, '10 minutes'),
    interval '1 second' * power(2, least(c."attempts", 20))
  )
  where k."name" = consumer;
  return 'retrying';
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: consumer text, owner text, failed bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint, error text DEFAULT NULL::text, max_attempts integer DEFAULT 10, max_backoff interval DEFAULT '00:10:00'::interval
functions.identity_argument_types: consumer text, owner text, failed bigint, error text, max_attempts integer, max_backoff interval

begin
  case pipeline_board.subject_type
    when 'deal' then
      return (
        with rows as (
          select r."stage_id" as stage_id, r."currency"::text as currency, r."amount"::bigint as amount,
            r."amount" * coalesce(r."probability", st."probability", 0) / 100.0 as weighted
          from "better_supabase"."deals" r
          join "better_supabase"."pipeline_stages" st on st."id" = r."stage_id"
          where r."pipeline_id" = pipeline_board.pipeline and r."archived_at" is null and (pipeline_board.owner is null or r."owner_user_id" = pipeline_board.owner)
        ),
        counts as (select stage_id, count(*) as n from rows group by stage_id),
        sums as (
          select stage_id, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('currency', currency, 'amount', amount::text, 'weighted', round(weighted)::bigint::text) order by currency) as totals
          from (select stage_id, currency, coalesce(sum(amount), 0) as amount, coalesce(sum(weighted), 0) as weighted from rows where currency is not null group by stage_id, currency) x
          group by stage_id
        )
        select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'stageId', st."id", 'key', st."key", 'name', st."name", 'color', st."color",
          'category', st."category", 'outcome', st."outcome", 'probability', st."probability",
          'wipLimit', st."wip_limit", 'count', coalesce(n.n, 0),
          'overLimit', st."wip_limit" is not null and coalesce(n.n, 0) > st."wip_limit",
          'totals', coalesce(m.totals, '[]'::jsonb)
        ) order by st."rank" collate "C"), '[]'::jsonb)
        from "better_supabase"."pipeline_stages" st
        left join counts n on n.stage_id = st."id"
        left join sums m on m.stage_id = st."id"
        where st."pipeline_id" = pipeline_board.pipeline and st."archived_at" is null
      );
    when 'work_item' then
      return (
        with rows as (
          select r."stage_id" as stage_id, null::text as currency, null::bigint as amount, null::numeric as weighted
          from "better_supabase"."work_items" r
          join "better_supabase"."pipeline_stages" st on st."id" = r."stage_id"
          where r."pipeline_id" = pipeline_board.pipeline and r."archived_at" is null
        ),
        counts as (select stage_id, count(*) as n from rows group by stage_id),
        sums as (
          select stage_id, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('currency', currency, 'amount', amount::text, 'weighted', round(weighted)::bigint::text) order by currency) as totals
          from (select stage_id, currency, coalesce(sum(amount), 0) as amount, coalesce(sum(weighted), 0) as weighted from rows where currency is not null group by stage_id, currency) x
          group by stage_id

functions.definition:
with window_rows as (
    select * from "better_supabase"."pipeline_stage_history" h
    where h."pipeline_id" = pipeline_stats.pipeline
      and h."entered_at" >= pipeline_stats.since and h."entered_at" < pipeline_stats.until
  ),
  per_stage as (
    select w."to_stage_id" as stage_id, count(*) as entered,
      avg(extract(epoch from (w."exited_at" - w."entered_at"))) filter (where w."exited_at" is not null) as avg_seconds
    from window_rows w group by w."to_stage_id"
  ),
  closed as (
    select count(*) filter (where w."outcome" = 'success') as won,
      count(*) filter (where w."outcome" = 'failure') as lost
    from window_rows w
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'won', closed.won,
    'lost', closed.lost,
    'winRate', case when closed.won + closed.lost = 0 then null else round(closed.won::numeric / (closed.won + closed.lost), 4) end,
    'stages', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('stageId', st."id", 'key', st."key", 'entered', coalesce(ps.entered, 0), 'averageSeconds', round(ps.avg_seconds)) order by st."rank" collate "C")
      from "better_supabase"."pipeline_stages" st left join per_stage ps on ps.stage_id = st."id"
      where st."pipeline_id" = pipeline_stats.pipeline
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  from closed;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.pull_document_updates(document_id uuid, after_seq bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_doc "better_supabase"."documents"%rowtype;
  v_snapshot "better_supabase"."document_snapshots"%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v_doc from "better_supabase"."documents" d where d."id" = pull_document_updates.document_id;
  if not found or not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'documents.read'), false) and case v_doc."subject_type"
    when 'message' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'conversation' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."conversations" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'channel' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."channels" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'company' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."companies" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'parties.read'), false)
    when 'person' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."people" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'parties.read'), false)
    when 'deal' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."deals" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'deals.read'), false)
    when 'engagement' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."engagements" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'engagements.read'), false)
    when 'work_item' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_items" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'work_items.read'), false)
    when 'employee' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."employees" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'employees.read'), false)
    when 'product' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."products" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'catalog.read'), false)
    when 'product_variant' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."product_variants" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'catalog.read'), false)
    when 'calendar_event' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."calendar_events" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'calendar.read'), false)
    when 'document' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'documents.read'), false)
    when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'customers.read'), false)
    when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'drive.read'), false)
    when 'application' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'hiring.read'), false)
    when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id")
    when 'task' then exists (select 1 from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id")
    else false
  end)) then
    raise exception 'document not found' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  select * into v_snapshot from "better_supabase"."document_snapshots" x where x."document_id" = v_doc."id";
  if v_snapshot."document_id" is not null and pull_document_updates.after_seq < v_snapshot."seq" then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'snapshot', replace(encode(v_snapshot."state", 'base64'), E'\n', ''),
      'snapshotSeq', v_snapshot."seq",
      'updates', "better_supabase"."document_updates_after"(v_doc."id", v_snapshot."seq")
    );
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('updates', "better_supabase"."document_updates_after"(v_doc."id", pull_document_updates.after_seq));
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.purge_ai_cache(batch integer DEFAULT 5000)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_count integer;
begin
  delete from "better_supabase"."ai_cache_entries" x
  where x."key" in (
    select y."key" from "better_supabase"."ai_cache_entries" y
    where y."expires_at" <= now()
    order by y."expires_at"
    limit least(greatest(purge_ai_cache.batch, 1), 50000)
    for update skip locked
  );
  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
  return v_count;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.purge_ai_files(older_than interval DEFAULT '1 day'::interval, batch integer DEFAULT 500)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_removed jsonb;
begin
  with doomed as (
    select x."id" from "better_supabase"."ai_files" x
    where (x."status" = 'pending' and x."created_at" <= now() - coalesce(older_than, interval '1 day'))
      or x."expires_at" <= now()
      or (x."chat_id" is not null and not exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."ai_chats" ch where ch."id" = x."chat_id"))
    limit greatest(coalesce(batch, 500), 1)
  ),
  gone as (
    delete from "better_supabase"."ai_files" x using doomed where x."id" = doomed."id"
    returning x."bucket" as bucket, x."path" as path
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('bucket', gone.bucket, 'path', gone.path)), '[]'::jsonb) into v_removed from gone;
  return v_removed;
end;
$function$

declare

    where "depth" = 0 and "purge_after" <= now()
      and not "better_supabase"."is_held"('trash', ("tenant_id")::text)

    limit greatest(coalesce(purge_expired_trash.max_batches, 100), 1)

  end loop;
  return v_count;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.purge_notifications(older_than interval DEFAULT '90 days'::interval, batch integer DEFAULT 10000)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_purged integer;
begin
  delete from "better_supabase"."notification_events"
  where "id" in (
    select ev."id" from "better_supabase"."notification_events" ev
    where (ev."created_at" < now() - least(coalesce(older_than, '90 days'), "better_supabase"."retention_floor"('notifications'))
      and ev."created_at" < now() - coalesce("better_supabase"."retention_for"('notifications', (ev."organization_id")::text), coalesce(older_than, '90 days'))
      and not "better_supabase"."is_held"('notifications', (ev."organization_id")::text))
    order by ev."created_at"
    limit coalesce(batch, 10000)
  );
  get diagnostics v_purged = row_count;
  return v_purged;
end;
$function$

declare
  v_purged integer;
begin
  with active as (
    select k."cursor_xid", k."cursor_position" from "better_supabase"."outbox_consumers" k
    where ignore_idle is null or k."updated_at" >= now() - ignore_idle
  ),
  letters as (
    delete from "better_supabase"."outbox_dead_letters" x
    where (x."dead_at" < now() - least(coalesce(older_than, '30 days'::interval), "better_supabase"."retention_floor"('outbox'))
      and x."dead_at" < now() - coalesce("better_supabase"."retention_for"('outbox', (null)::text), coalesce(older_than, '30 days'::interval))
      and not "better_supabase"."is_held"('outbox', (null)::text))
  ),
  gone as (
    delete from "better_supabase"."outbox_events" e
    where e."id" in (
      select d."id" from "better_supabase"."outbox_events" d
      where (d."created_at" < now() - least(coalesce(older_than, '30 days'::interval), "better_supabase"."retention_floor"('outbox'))
      and d."created_at" < now() - coalesce("better_supabase"."retention_for"('outbox', (d."organization_id")::text), coalesce(older_than, '30 days'::interval))
      and not "better_supabase"."is_held"('outbox', (d."organization_id")::text))
        and (
          not exists (select 1 from active)
          or (d."xid", d."position") <= (
            select a."cursor_xid", a."cursor_position" from active a
            order by a."cursor_xid", a."cursor_position"
            limit 1
          )
        )
      order by d."created_at"
      limit coalesce(batch, 10000)
    )
    returning 1
  )
  select count(*)::integer into v_purged from gone;
  return v_purged;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.purge_webhook_deliveries(older_than interval DEFAULT '30 days'::interval, include_dead boolean DEFAULT false, batch integer DEFAULT 10000)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_purged integer;
begin
  with purged as (
    delete from "better_supabase"."webhook_deliveries"
    where "id" in (
      select v."id" from "better_supabase"."webhook_deliveries" v
      where (v."created_at" < now() - least(purge_webhook_deliveries.older_than, "better_supabase"."retention_floor"('webhook_deliveries'))
      and v."created_at" < now() - coalesce("better_supabase"."retention_for"('webhook_deliveries', (v."organization_id")::text), purge_webhook_deliveries.older_than)
      and not "better_supabase"."is_held"('webhook_deliveries', (v."organization_id")::text))
        and (
          v."status" in ('succeeded', 'canceled')
          or (purge_webhook_deliveries.include_dead and v."status" = 'dead')
        )
      limit purge_webhook_deliveries.batch
    )
    returning 1
  )
  select count(*)::integer into v_purged from purged;
  return v_purged;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.push_document_update(document_id uuid, payload text)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_doc "better_supabase"."documents"%rowtype;
  v_bytes bytea;
  v_seq bigint;
  v_since bigint;
begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;
  select * into v_doc from "better_supabase"."documents" d where d."id" = push_document_update.document_id;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'document not found' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'documents.write'), false) and case v_doc."subject_type"
    when 'message' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'conversation' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."conversations" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'channel' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."channels" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'company' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."companies" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'parties.read'), false)
    when 'person' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."people" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'parties.read'), false)
    when 'deal' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."deals" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'deals.read'), false)
    when 'engagement' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."engagements" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'engagements.read'), false)
    when 'work_item' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_items" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'work_items.read'), false)
    when 'employee' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."employees" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'employees.read'), false)
    when 'product' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."products" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'catalog.read'), false)
    when 'product_variant' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."product_variants" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'catalog.read'), false)
    when 'calendar_event' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."calendar_events" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'calendar.read'), false)
    when 'document' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'documents.read'), false)
    when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'customers.read'), false)
    when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'drive.read'), false)
    when 'application' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'hiring.read'), false)
    when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id")
    when 'task' then exists (select 1 from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id")
    else false
  end and case v_doc."subject_type"
    when 'message' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.send'), false)
    when 'conversation' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.send'), false)
    when 'channel' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'channels.manage'), false)
    when 'company' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'parties.write'), false)
    when 'person' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'parties.write'), false)
    when 'deal' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'deals.write'), false)
    when 'engagement' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'engagements.write'), false)
    when 'work_item' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'work_items.write'), false)
    when 'employee' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'employees.write'), false)
    when 'product' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'catalog.manage'), false)
    when 'product_variant' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'catalog.manage'), false)
    when 'calendar_event' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'calendar.write'), false)
    when 'document' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'documents.write'), false)
    when 'customer' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'customers.write'), false)
    when 'drive_node' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'drive.manage'), false)
    when 'application' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'hiring.write'), false)
    else true
  end)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to edit this document' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'DOCUMENT_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  begin
    v_bytes := decode(push_document_update.payload, 'base64');
  exception when others then
    raise exception 'the update must be base64' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'DOCUMENT_UPDATE_INVALID';
  end;
  if v_bytes is null or length(v_bytes) = 0 then
    raise exception 'the update is empty' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'DOCUMENT_UPDATE_INVALID';
  end if;
  if length(v_bytes) > 1048576 then
    raise exception 'an update can be at most 1048576 bytes' using errcode = '54000', hint = 'DOCUMENT_UPDATE_TOO_LARGE';
  end if;
  insert into "better_supabase"."document_updates" ("document_id", "tenant_id", "payload", "actor")
  values (v_doc."id", v_doc."tenant_id", v_bytes, auth.uid())
  returning "seq" into v_seq;
  update "better_supabase"."documents" d set "updated_at" = now() where d."id" = v_doc."id";
  select count(*) into v_since from "better_supabase"."document_updates" x
  where x."document_id" = v_doc."id"
    and x."seq" > coalesce((select y."seq" from "better_supabase"."document_snapshots" y where y."document_id" = v_doc."id"), 0);
  if v_since = 200 then
    perform "better_supabase"."enqueue_job"(queue => 'documents.compact', payload => jsonb_build_object('documentId', v_doc."id"), dedupe_key => 'documents.compact:' || v_doc."id"::text, dedupe_running => false);
  end if;
  return v_seq;
end;
$function$

functions.definition:
declare
  v_count integer := 0;
begin
  case rebalance_ranks.subject_type
    when 'deal' then
      with ordered as (
        select s."id" as row_id,
          row_number() over (partition by s."stage_id" order by s."rank" collate "C", s."id") as nth,
          count(*) over (partition by s."stage_id") as total
        from "better_supabase"."deals" s
        where s."tenant_id"::text = rebalance_ranks.tenant
          and (rebalance_ranks.rank_group is null or s."stage_id"::text = rebalance_ranks.rank_group)
      )
      update "better_supabase"."deals" t set "rank" = "better_supabase"."rank_key"(o.nth, o.total)
      from ordered o
      where t."id" = o.row_id;
      get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
    when 'work_item' then
      with ordered as (
        select s."id" as row_id,
          row_number() over (partition by s."stage_id" order by s."rank" collate "C", s."id") as nth,
          count(*) over (partition by s."stage_id") as total
        from "better_supabase"."work_items" s
        where s."tenant_id"::text = rebalance_ranks.tenant
          and (rebalance_ranks.rank_group is null or s."stage_id"::text = rebalance_ranks.rank_group)
      )
      update "better_supabase"."work_items" t set "rank" = "better_supabase"."rank_key"(o.nth, o.total)
      from ordered o
      where t."id" = o.row_id;
      get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
    when 'application' then
      with ordered as (
        select s."id" as row_id,
          row_number() over (partition by s."stage_id" order by s."rank" collate "C", s."id") as nth,
          count(*) over (partition by s."stage_id") as total
        from "better_supabase"."applications" s
        where s."tenant_id"::text = rebalance_ranks.tenant
          and (rebalance_ranks.rank_group is null or s."stage_id"::text = rebalance_ranks.rank_group)
      )
      update "better_supabase"."applications" t set "rank" = "better_supabase"."rank_key"(o.nth, o.total)
      from ordered o
      where t."id" = o.row_id;
      get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
    when 'task' then
      with ordered as (
        select s."id" as row_id,
          row_number() over (partition by s."status" order by s."rank" collate "C", s."id") as nth,
          count(*) over (partition by s."status") as total
        from "public"."tasks" s
        where s."organization_id"::text = rebalance_ranks.tenant
          and (rebalance_ranks.rank_group is null or s."status"::text = rebalance_ranks.rank_group)
      )
      update "public"."tasks" t set "rank" = "better_supabase"."rank_key"(o.nth, o.total)
      from ordered o
      where t."id" = o.row_id;
      get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
    else
      raise exception 'this subject type has no rank column in config.subjects' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'RANK_SUBJECT_UNKNOWN';
  end case;
  return v_count;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.record_ai_batch(tenant uuid, provider text, reference jsonb, fields jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_row "better_supabase"."ai_batches"%rowtype;
  v_fields jsonb := coalesce(record_ai_batch.fields, '{}');
begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (auth.uid() is not null and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', record_ai_batch.tenant, 'ai.create'), false))) then
    raise exception 'you may not start batches here' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'AI_BATCH_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  insert into "better_supabase"."ai_batches" ("organization_id", "user_id", "provider", "reference", "status", "raw_status", "item_count", "counts", "metadata", "expires_at", "next_poll_at")
  values (
    record_ai_batch.tenant,
    case when coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') then (v_fields ->> 'user_id')::uuid else auth.uid() end,
    record_ai_batch.provider,
    record_ai_batch.reference,
    coalesce(v_fields ->> 'status', 'pending'),
    v_fields ->> 'raw_status',
    coalesce((v_fields ->> 'item_count')::integer, 0),
    coalesce(v_fields -> 'counts', '{}'),
    coalesce(v_fields -> 'metadata', '{}'),
    (v_fields ->> 'expires_at')::timestamptz,
    now() + interval '60 seconds'
  )
  returning * into v_row;
  return jsonb_build_object('id', v_row."id", 'organization_id', v_row."organization_id", 'user_id', v_row."user_id", 'provider', v_row."provider", 'reference', v_row."reference", 'status', v_row."status", 'raw_status', v_row."raw_status", 'item_count', v_row."item_count", 'counts', v_row."counts", 'error', v_row."error", 'metadata', v_row."metadata", 'results_saved', v_row."results_saved", 'polls', v_row."polls", 'next_poll_at', v_row."next_poll_at", 'expires_at', v_row."expires_at", 'completed_at', v_row."completed_at", 'created_at', v_row."created_at", 'updated_at', v_row."updated_at");
end;
$function$

  insert into "better_supabase"."message_deliveries" as d ("tenant_id", "message_id", "channel", "external_id", "status", "error", "attempts")
  select m."tenant_id", m."id", record_delivery.channel, record_delivery.external_id, coalesce(record_delivery.status, 'sent'), record_delivery.error, 1
  from "better_supabase"."inbox_messages" m where m."id" = record_delivery.message
  on conflict ("message_id", "channel") do update set
    "external_id" = coalesce(excluded."external_id", d."external_id"),
    "status" = excluded."status",
    "error" = excluded."error",
    "attempts" = d."attempts" + 1
  returning * into v_row;

functions.definition:
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', e.id, 'kind', n.seen, 'direction', e.direction,
    'type', e.other_type, 'subjectId', e.other_id,
    'data', e.data, 'createdAt', e.created_at
  ) order by n.seen, e.created_at, e.id), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select r."id" as id, r."kind" as canonical, 'out' as direction,
      r."target_type" as other_type, r."target_id" as other_id, r."data" as data, r."created_at" as created_at
    from "better_supabase"."relations" r
    where r."tenant_id" = relations_of.tenant and r."source_type" = relations_of.subject_type and r."source_id" = relations_of.subject_id
    union all
    select r."id", r."kind", 'in', r."source_type", r."source_id", r."data", r."created_at"
    from "better_supabase"."relations" r
    where r."tenant_id" = relations_of.tenant and r."target_type" = relations_of.subject_type and r."target_id" = relations_of.subject_id
  ) e
  cross join lateral (
    select case when e.direction = 'in' and not k.both_ways then k.opposite else k.canonical end as seen
    from (values ('blocks', 'blocks', false, true, false, false, 'blocked_by'), ('blocked_by', 'blocks', true, true, false, false, 'blocks'), ('parent', 'parent', false, true, true, false, 'children'), ('children', 'parent', true, true, true, false, 'parent'), ('relates', 'relates', false, false, false, true, 'relates'), ('created_from', 'created_from', false, true, true, false, 'converted_to'), ('converted_to', 'created_from', true, true, true, false, 'created_from')) as k(name, canonical, inverted, acyclic, single, both_ways, opposite)
    where k.name = e.canonical
  ) n
  where relations_of.kind is null or n.seen = relations_of.kind

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.remind_approvals(after interval DEFAULT '1 day'::interval, max_requests integer DEFAULT 200)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_id uuid;
  v_count integer := 0;
begin
  for v_id in
    update "better_supabase"."approval_requests" r set "reminded_at" = now()
    where r."id" in (
      select x."id" from "better_supabase"."approval_requests" x
      where x."status" = 'pending'
        and (x."expires_at" is null or x."expires_at" > now())
        and x."created_at" <= now() - remind_approvals.after
        and (x."reminded_at" is null or x."reminded_at" <= now() - remind_approvals.after)
      order by x."created_at"
      limit greatest(coalesce(remind_approvals.max_requests, 200), 1)
      for update skip locked
    )
    returning r."id"
  loop
    perform "better_supabase"."approval_notify"(v_id, 'reminder');
    v_count := v_count + 1;
  end loop;
  return v_count;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.replace_equivalent_triggers(target regclass, module_trigger text, pattern text, replace_trigger boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  found record;
begin
  for found in
    select t.tgname as name, p.proname as fn
    from pg_catalog.pg_trigger t
    join pg_catalog.pg_proc p on p.oid = t.tgfoid
    where t.tgrelid = replace_equivalent_triggers.target
      and not t.tgisinternal
      and t.tgname <> replace_equivalent_triggers.module_trigger
      and p.proname ~* replace_equivalent_triggers.pattern
  loop
    if replace_trigger then
      execute format('drop trigger %I on %s', found.name, target);
    else
      raise warning '% already has trigger % (%), which does what % does. Pass replace_trigger => true to drop it.',
        target, found.name, found.fn, module_trigger;
    end if;
  end loop;
end;
$function$

    raise exception 'You may not cancel this run' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'WORKFLOW_FORBIDDEN';

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.resolve_notifications(type text, subject_type text, subject_id text, tenant uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_changed jsonb;
begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;
  if not ((coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin')) or coalesce(better_supabase.member_can(auth.uid(), resolve_notifications.tenant, 'notifications.send'), false)) then
    raise exception 'Not allowed to resolve notifications here' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'NOTIFICATION_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  with rc as (
    update "better_supabase"."notification_recipients" rc
    set "resolved_at" = now(), "read_at" = coalesce(rc."read_at", now())
    from "better_supabase"."notification_events" ev
    where ev."id" = rc."event_id"
      and ev."type" = resolve_notifications.type
      and ev."subject_type" = resolve_notifications.subject_type
      and ev."subject_id" = resolve_notifications.subject_id
      and ev."organization_id" is not distinct from resolve_notifications.tenant
      and rc."resolved_at" is null
      and rc."dismissed_at" is null
    returning rc.*
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'count', count(*),
    'items', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', rc."id", 'event_id', ev."id", 'type', ev."type", 'data', ev."data", 'created_at', rc."created_at", 'read_at', rc."read_at", 'tenant', ev."organization_id", 'actor_id', ev."actor_id", 'subject_type', ev."subject_type", 'subject_id', ev."subject_id", 'subject_label', ev."subject_label", 'summary', ev."summary", 'action_path', ev."action_path", 'priority', ev."priority", 'resolved_at', rc."resolved_at") order by rc."created_at" desc, rc."id" desc) filter (where rc."user_id" = auth.uid()), '[]')
  )
  from rc
  join "better_supabase"."notification_events" ev on ev."id" = rc."event_id" into v_changed;
  return v_changed;
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: type text, subject_type text, subject_id text, tenant uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid
functions.identity_argument_types: type text, subject_type text, subject_id text, tenant uuid
